items.title: Senior Director, Data & Performance
items.summary: As theSenior Director of Data & Performance, you’ll lead the design, governance, and continuous improvement of data systems, analytics tools, and performance reporting infrastructure for Acelero, Inc.
items.description: As the Senior Director of Data & Performance , you’ll lead the design, governance, and continuous improvement of data systems, analytics tools, and performance reporting infrastructure for Acelero, Inc. This role ensures that the organization's data practices promote transparency, compliance, and strategic decision-making across Acelero Learning delegates and Shine Early Learning partners. Why Acelero? Our mission is bold: To design and deliver research and evidence-based approaches to eliminate the gaps between young childrenʼs inherent potential and their achievement in school and life. With our partners, we accelerate child and family outcomes that honor all of the aspirations and cultures of the communities we serve. Our values: Data-Informed Learning; Transparent & Open Communication; Growth Mindset; Championing Equality; Caring Teams & Communities. Your Role: As a Senior Director you will manage a centralized team responsible for dashboard development, recurring and ad hoc reporting, and the integration of data systems across the network — and serve as the primary data partner to delegate leadership, including Delegate Vice Presidents, local Boards of Directors, and AHSGAC. What You’ll Do: Data Governance & Infrastructure Establish and maintain organizational data governance frameworks, including data quality standards, ownership roles, documentation practices, and privacy safeguards. Lead the development and management of end-to-end data lifecycle infrastructure — including ingestion, transformation, validation, storage, automation, and visualization — in collaboration with IT, ensuring seamless systems integration and automation across platforms to support scalable, real-time analytics and decision-making. Maintain database structure, field alignment, and access protocols in collaboration with IT and database administrators to ensure data usability, reporting accuracy, and compliance with governance policies. Ensure compliance with data privacy laws, security protocols, and internal risk mitigation measures. Dashboard, Reporting & Analytics Oversight Supervise the development, maintenance, and continuous improvement of the organizational ecosystem of dashboards — including MBE, MBO, MBI, and AceleroStat — for internal teams, delegates, and external partners. Oversee the production of recurring reports and custom analytics requests from internal teams, delegates, and Shine partners. Ensure timely end-of-month reporting to the Office of Head Start, maintaining accuracy, completeness, and compliance with fed eral reporting requirements across all delegate programs. Lead the scope, sequence, and fidelity of product development for the Annual Program Information Report (PIR) — ensuring the PIR reflects accurate program data, meets federal specifications, and is executed with consistency across the network. Ensure readiness, accuracy, and completion of Head Start data submissions, including the PIR, Enrollment and Attendance Dashboards, and Federal Monitoring Review data requests. Translate data into actionable insights and communicate performance findings clearly to executive audiences, including senior leadership and the Board of Directors. Data Product Innovation & Cross-Functional Partnership Lead the design and development of new data and performance products that advance organizational decision-making, delegate accountability, and external reporting — moving beyond maintaining existing systems to actively identifying where new tools, visualizations, or analytical frameworks would create meaningful value. Partner closely with the Product Team on the design, scoping, and development of data products — serving as the primary LIT voice on data architecture decisions, ensuring that products reflect how data is actually generated, used, and interpreted across the delegate network. Bring an innovation lens to the full data and performance portfolio: regularly assess whether existing dashboards, reports, and data tools are still fit for purpose, and lead the process of retiring, replacing, or redesigning them when they are not. Identify emerging technologies, analytical methodologies, and sector-wide data practices that could strengthen Acelero's data infrastructure, and make the case for adoption when the evidence warrants it. Ensure that product development decisions are grounded in implementation reality — not theoretical design — by maintaining close feedback loops with Directors of Analysis, delegate leaders, and program staff who use data tools in practice. Federal Planning & Needs Assessment Support Provide data collection resources, infrastructure, and analytical support for Community Needs Assessment (CNA) updates and five-year grant renewal planning — ensuring data systems are positioned to generate the evidence base these processes require. Collaborate with program leadership and delegate teams to ensure CNA and five-year update processes are grounded in timely, accurate, and well-organized data. Delegate Engagement & Governance Interface Serve as the primary data partner and liaison to delegate leadership, including Delegate Vice Presidents, local Boards of Directors, and AHSGAC, ensuring data and performance strategies align with local and organizational priorities. Present performance data, insights, and strategic recommendations to AHSGAC and the Policy Council, ensuring transparency, accessibility, and relevance to governance decision-making. Collaborate with Directors of Analysis to ensure data systems and dashboards reflect the realities and priorities of program operations across all service areas. Participate actively in delegate start-up, expansion, and transition planning, ensuring alignment of data systems and infrastructure with implementation strategies and compliance requirements. Represent the Data & Performance function in cross-delegate convenings, planning sessions, and the Annual Joint Board, Policy Council, and Staff Planning, Training, and Elections Event. Compliance & Continuous Improvement Oversee compliance-related reporting and dashboards that support Head Start monitoring, licensing, and internal audits. Partner with the SD, Compliance & Program Fidelity to ensure compliance metrics are integrated with quality metrics in all reporting, and that data systems support corrective action monitoring and regulatory readiness. Leverage data to identify trends, risks, and improvement opportunities across service areas and delegate performance. Lead standardization of reporting templates, data definitions, and KPIs across the organization to ensure consistent interpretation of key metrics. Oversee the creation and maintenance of data documentation, including data dictionaries, SOPs, and internal guides to support recurring reporting, dashboard development, and compliance tracking. Team Management & Leadership Lead and develop a high-performing team, overseeing work allocation, goal setting, project timelines, and professional development across the Data & Performance function. Direct reports include: Manager, Data Design & Reporting; Specialist, Data Design & Reporting; Director of Analysis, CC; Director of Analysis, WW/MM; Director of Analysis, CP; Director of Analysis, DE/SC . Establish formal feedback mechanisms with delegate leadership on satisfaction with Directors of Analysis and their teams, using insights to inform coaching and annual performance evaluations. Build data literacy and data use capacity among delegate leaders and LIT staff through training, tools, and technical assistance. Supervision Supervises assigned department personnel including hiring, training, scheduling, evaluating, and ensuring accuracy, timeliness, and completion of work performed by direct reports. Meets with assigned staff regularly to identify and resolve problems, manage projects, track goals, and review work processes and procedures. Represents team and/or department at meetings, events, and training as required. What You Bring: Bachelor's degree required; Master's degree in data science, analytics, education policy, or related field is a strong asset. Minimum of five (5) years of experience in data analytics, performance management, or systems leadership. At least three (3) years in a management or supervisory role, including leading cross-functional data teams. Head Start, early education, public sector, or human services data experience is highly valued. Experience in data governance, data pipeline development, or ETL processes. Physical exam and background checks required. Travel up to 10%, required for work-related meetings, training, and partner support. Must have a valid driver's license and reliable transportation. When/Where/How Much: When : Summer 2026 Where : Remote with 10% travel How Much : This positions pays up to $140,000 + comprehensive benefits package Why You’ll Love Working with Us: A meaningful mission that drives real change in the lives of children and families A collaborative, inclusive team that values your growth and well-being Robust benefits that support your total wellbeing, including: Medical, Dental, and Vision Insurance with multiple plan options to fit your needs Health Savings Account (HSA) with company contributions up to $400/individuals & $800/family annually Flexible Spending Accounts (FSA) for health and dependent care expenses 401(k) Retirement Plan with up to 3% company match Short-Term and Long-Term Disability and Basic Life Insurance Up to $500 per year in Professional Development Reimbursements Employee Assistance Program (EAP) with counseling and mental wellness support Wellness Programs, including virtual fitness, nutrition, and mindfulness classes Pet Insurance, Legal Assistance, ID Theft Protection, and Employee Discount Perks Why Join Acelero Learning? At Acelero Learning and Shine Early Learning , we're committed to transforming early childhood education through innovation, continuous learning, and a relentless focus on quality. You'll join a collaborative team that values curiosity, creativity, and continuous improvement while making a meaningful impact on the educators who shape children's futures every day. We are an equal opportunity employer, committed to creating a diverse and healthy workplace. Originally posted on Himalayas

Our platform automates billing and collections so businesses can focus on growth. At Anchor, we’re redefining the future of B2B Payments. We empower businesses to focus on their core strengths while we handle the complexities of billing and collections. Reporting directly to the COO of Anchor, the ideal candidate will demonstrate exceptional ownership, a holistic business mindset, meticulous attention to detail, and a consultative, action-oriented approach that truly sets them apart. Develop and execute a comprehensive CS strategy that aligns with customer goals and drives measurable value. Own and evolve onboarding, account management, and customer support processes that maximize adoption and satisfaction. Build deep, trusted relationships with customers—including executive stakeholders—and act as their strategic advisor. Highly detailed and structured professional, with experience designing and implementing scalable CS processes. Superb capabilities in managing even the most challenging customer relationships—able to turn difficult moments into positive, productive outcomes. items.description: About Dutchie Founded in 2017, Dutchie is a comprehensive technology platform powering dispensary operations, while providing consumers with safe and easy access to cannabis. Dutchie aims to further support the positive societal change the cannabis industry brings to the world through wellness benefits, social justice, and empowering local communities through tax revenue. Powering thousands of dispensaries across 40+ markets throughout the United States and Canada, Dutchie is the leading technology company in the cannabis space and was named in Fast Company’s 10 Most Innovative Companies in North America and listed two years in a row on LinkedIn’s Top 50 Startups. Dutchie has raised over $600M in funding to date, backed by D1 Capital Partners, Tiger Global, Dragoneer, DFJ Growth, Thrive Capital, Howard Schultz, Snoop Dogg’s Casa Verde Capital, Gron Ventures, members of the founding team at DoorDash, Kevin Durant’s Thirty Five Ventures, and other notable angel investors. About This Role Dutchie is looking for a Senior Financial Planning & Analysis Analyst to help drive the financial operating rhythm of the company. You’ll partner across Finance, Accounting, and business leaders to build forecasts, evaluate performance, improve planning processes, and deliver insights that influence executive decision-making. This role is ideal for someone who enjoys building scalable financial infrastructure, automating manual work, and using data to tell compelling business stories. You’ll report to the Senior Director of FP&A while helping establish the next generation of planning capabilities across Dutchie . What You’ll Do Financial Planning & Forecasting Own portions of the annual operating plan, quarterly forecasts, and long-range financial planning process. Develop financial models that improve visibility into company performance and future investment decisions. Analyze monthly results, identify business drivers, and communicate actionable insights to leadership. Partner closely with Accounting to ensure accurate reporting and alignment between actuals, forecasts, and KPIs. Operational Excellence Improve and automate planning workflows using AI, modern financial tooling, and scalable processes. Identify opportunities to eliminate manual reporting through automation and self-service analytics. Help evolve executive reporting and dashboards that improve decision-making across the organization. Support board materials, leadership presentations, and strategic planning initiatives. Cross-Functional Partnership Collaborate across R&D, G&A, and Operations to understand business performance and financial impact. Become a trusted finance partner capable of simplifying complex business questions into clear financial recommendations. Help establish consistent planning disciplines as Dutchie continues to scale. What You’ll Bring 3–5 years of experience in FP&A, investment banking, consulting, or corporate finance. Advanced financial modeling and Excel skills with experience building dynamic forecasting models. Experience working in high-growth SaaS or technology environments preferred. Strong analytical curiosity and comfort working through ambiguity. Experience leveraging AI tools to automate analysis, improve workflows, and increase productivity. Excellent communication skills with the ability to translate complex analyses into executive-ready recommendations. Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, or related field. What You’ll Get We are targeting a starting salary of $124,000 - $166,000 based on the intended level for this role. In addition to cash compensation, our total rewards package includes: Full medical benefits including dental and vision plans to ensure you always have the best care. Equity packages in the form of stock options to all employees. Technology (hardware, software, reading materials, etc..) allowance Flexible vacation and sick days At Dutchie , we’re committed to providing an environment of mutual respect where equal employment opportunities are available to all applicants and teammates without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, pregnancy, age, national origin, disability status, genetic information, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. items.summary: Shape the Future on AutopilotAt Autopilot, you won’t just design screens – you’ll design how fintech works.
items.description: Shape the Future on Autopilot At Autopilot , you won’t just design screens – you’ll design how fintech works. As a Product Designer , you’ll own product experiences end-to-end and help redefine what great UX means in a complex, data-driven industry. We’re building a high-performance, AI-native Fintech Operating System designed to optimize cost and revenue for digital businesses. Join us on a multi-year mission to build smarter infrastructure for commerce. Why Join Us? You’ll help build an ambitious product from the ground up, with a team that values speed, craft, and autonomy. If you’re ready to make an outsized impact in fintech, we’d love to meet you. About the Role You'll join a fast-moving team building modern, data-intensive web applications that help digital businesses operate more intelligently. This is a founding design role with strong emphasis on product logic, systems thinking, and end-to-end collaboration with engineers. 🛠️ What You'll Do Translate complex financial logic and backend systems into intuitive user flows Design dashboards, workflows, and visual systems for payments, orchestration, and automation Build and maintain our scalable design system in Figma (aligned with React components) Collaborate with engineers on real-world UX states — success, failure, pending, retry Prototype and validate features with real data and user context Participate in product discussions, shaping user journeys before pixels are drawn Uphold usability and domain accuracy as the standard for design quality 🎯 What We're Looking For 5+ years of experience designing digital products with complex logic (fintech, B2B SaaS, or data-heavy systems preferred) Strong product and systems thinking — you design for states and workflows , not just screens Deep Figma expertise (Auto Layout, Variants, Tokens, Components) Ability to translate backend logic, APIs, and data models into coherent user experiences Excellent communication and documentation skills (Linear, Figma, Slack) Comfortable working directly with engineers and iterating quickly without handoffs 🌟 Bonus Points Experience in fintech, payments, or compliance-related products Exposure to analytics or developer tooling Understanding of design-to-code workflows (React component parity, tokens) Strong interaction or motion design craft (Framer, ProtoPie, etc.) Our Hiring Process We focus on real-world collaboration, not design showreels. Here’s what to expect: Apply with LinkedIn Profile And Resume We’ll review based on the requirements above. If shortlisted, you’ll receive an email to schedule a 90-minute live design collaboration session once you’re comfortable with our pre-interview brief. 90-Minute Live Design Collaboration You’ll work with our product and engineering team on a small feature challenge — from user problem to Figma prototype. We’ll look at: How you think through logic and flows How you translate constraints into UX decisions Your interaction, hierarchy, and state management How you communicate trade-offs and rationale The session mirrors our actual workflow: accessible pragmatic collaborative Design Review & Feedback After the session, we’ll walk through your design decisions together. You’ll get feedback from our CTO and team, and discuss potential improvements or extensions to your solution. Culture & Alignment Chat A final call with CEO to discuss your long-term goals, how you work best, and whether Autopilot is the right fit for both sides. Originally posted on Himalayas

items.description: Product Headquarters: Remote - US Who we are At Twilio, we’re shaping the future of communications, all from the comfort of our homes. We deliver innovative solutions to hundreds of thousands of businesses and empower millions of developers worldwide to craft personalized customer experiences. Our dedication to remote-first work , and strong culture of connection and global inclusion means that no matter your location, you’re part of a vibrant team with diverse experiences making a global impact each day. As we continue to revolutionize how the world interacts, we’re acquiring new skills and experiences that make work feel truly rewarding. Your career at Twilio is in your hands. We use Artificial Intelligence (AI) to help make our hiring process efficient. That said, every hiring decision is made by real Twilions! . See yourself at Twilio Join the team as Twilio’s next Principal Product Manager About the job This position is needed to bridge complex, multi-year enterprise deal structures with seamless, institutional-grade product usage experiences. You will empower global sales teams by architecting intuitive commercial frameworks and building secure infrastructure for large corporate clients to manage financial assets and usage across Twilio. We seek an entrepreneurial leader passionate about solving technical scaling challenges at the intersection of traditional enterprise systems and next-generation technology. Responsibilities In this role, you’ll: Product Strategy & Vision: Define and drive the multi-year product roadmap for the consumption based billing ecosystem, aligning with corporate treasury, finance and GTM teams. Own the long-term vision for building extensible capabilities that support complex, multi-year, sales-led agreements. Governance & Security Infrastructure: Design robust, multi-user approval workflows, role-based privileges, and integrate institutional-grade security models API & Developer Experience: Champion the developer journey and experiences. . Compliance & Treasury Integration: Collaborate with legal, compliance, and engineering teams to ensure the platform meets global regulatory payment and consumption billing standards. Qualifications Twilio values diverse experiences from all kinds of industries, and we encourage everyone who meets the required qualifications to apply. If your career is just starting or hasn't followed a traditional path, don't let that stop you from considering Twilio. We are always looking for people who will bring something new to the table! *Required: 10+ Years of Product Leadership: A proven track record of managing high-impact products within SaaS, PaaS, FinTech, or developer platform ecosystems. Entrepreneurial Mindset & Strategic Acumen: A self-starter attitude with a deep understanding of how large B2B organizations, GTM teams, and complex, multi-year enterprise sales cycles operate. Consumption Billing: Familiarity with modern lare scale consumption billing infrastructure, enterprise payment and billing management Strong Technical Chops: The ability to go deep with engineering teams. You are comfortable discussing architectural trade-offs regarding APIs, scalability, and highly distributed ledger systems. Mastery of Cross-Functional Communication: Exceptional storytelling skills, with a knack for aligning internal executives, legal/compliance teams, sales orgs, and external enterprise stakeholders. Desired: Education: Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Business, or equivalent practical experience. Domain Experience: Prior experience building monetization, billing, pricing engines for top-tier platforms (e.g., AWS, Stripe, Snowflake). Technical Skills: Proficiency with SQL/analytics tools (Amplitude, Mixpanel, Tableau), agile delivery frameworks, and a track record of driving cross-functional alignment in remote-first cultures. Location This role will be remote, but is not eligible to be hired in CA, CT, NJ, NY, PA, WA. Travel We prioritize connection and opportunities to build relationships with our customers and each other. For this role, you may be required to travel occasionally to participate in project or team in-person meetings. What We Offer Working at Twilio offers many benefits, including competitive pay, generous time off, ample parental and wellness leave, healthcare, a retirement savings program, and much more. Offerings vary by location. Compensation *Please note this role is open to candidates outside of California, Colorado, Hawaii, Illinois, Maryland, Massachusetts, Minnesota, New Jersey, New York, Vermont, Washington D.C., and Washington State. The information below is provided for candidates hired in those locations only. The estimated pay ranges for this role are as follows: Based in Colorado, Hawaii, Illinois, Maryland, Massachusetts, Minnesota, Vermont or Washington D.C. : $171,120 - $213,900. Based in New York, New Jersey, Washington State, or California (outside of the San Francisco Bay area): $181,200 - $226,500. Based in the San Francisco Bay area, California: $201,280 - $251,600 . This role may be eligible to participate in Twilio’s equity plan and corporate bonus plan. All roles are generally eligible for the following benefits: health care insurance, 401(k) retirement account, paid sick time, paid personal time off, paid parental leave. The successful candidate’s starting salary will be determined based on permissible, non-discriminatory factors such as skills, experience, and geographic location. Application deadline information (required for ALL US jobs) Applications for this role are intended to be accepted until August 16, 2026, but may change based on business needs. Twilio thinks big. Do you? We like to solve problems, take initiative, pitch in when needed, and are always up for trying new things. That's why we seek out colleagues who embody our values — something we call Twilio Magic . Additionally, we empower employees to build positive change in their communities by supporting their volunteering and donation efforts. So, if you're ready to unleash your full potential, do your best work, and be the best version of yourself, apply now! If this role isn't what you're looking for, please consider other open positions. Twilio is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate based upon race, religion, color, national origin, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, reproductive health decisions, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, status as a protected veteran, status as an individual with a disability, genetic information, political views or activity, or other applicable legally protected characteristics. We also consider qualified applicants with criminal histories, consistent with applicable federal, state and local law. Qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records will be considered for employment in accordance with the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers and the California Fair Chance Act. Additionally, Twilio participates in the E-Verify program in certain locations, as required by law. To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/twilio-principal-product-manager-enterprise-commerce-platform

items.description: At Roofr, we’re obsessed with our customers. We constantly gather feedback to shape, prioritize, and launch the products they truly need. That’s what makes Roofr’s CRM special. We started by building essential sales tools like aerial roof measurements and digital sales proposals. But when our customers asked for a simple, affordable way to manage and scale their entire businesses, we listened. So, we created a CRM that connects these solutions—along with payments, material ordering, and more—into a seamless, powerful platform. With a clear roadmap ahead, we’re excited to continue expanding and leading the market with innovative products. We have an amazing culture, strong financials, and best-in-class company metrics. It’s an exciting time to be part of an extraordinary startup that is already successful, yet still early enough to offer its team significant growth, equity, and the opportunity to make a real impact. This position is for an existing vacancy. Reporting to the Chief Operating Officer, the Head of Customer Experience will define and execute Roofr’s post-sale customer strategy, leading Customer Experience team. This leader will be responsible for building a future-focused organization that leverages AI, automation, and digital-first experiences to accelerate customer time-to-value, improve retention, and deliver world-class customer experiences at scale. Success in this role requires an operator who can balance strategy and tactical execution to build high-performing teams, optimize processes, and partner cross-functionally with Product, Engineering, Sales, Marketing, and Revenue Operations to continuously optimize the end-to-end customer journey and create a cohesive experience across every customer touchpoint. What you’ll get to do: Build the Future of Customer Experience Develop and execute Roofr’s Customer Experience strategy aligned with our Product-Led Growth (PLG) and Product-Led Sales (PLS) models. Design a scalable customer journey that enables customers to achieve value quickly while creating a seamless experience across every customer touchpoint. Establish a customer-first culture focused on simplicity, speed, and measurable customer outcomes. Own the holistic customer experience across the post-sale lifecycle, identifying opportunities to improve the journey from onboarding through adoption, engagement, support, and retention. Create a consistent experience across digital, self-service, and human-assisted interactions. Lead Customer Operations Provide leadership and/or support across: Customer Support Onboarding & Customer Success ( Interim ) Customer Retention ( Interim ) Develop leaders, build organizational capability, establish operational rhythms, and create clear performance metrics that drive accountability and continuous improvement. Connect these functions into a cohesive Customer Experience organization, breaking down operational silos and ensuring customers experience a consistent journey regardless of how or where they engage with Roofr. Drive AI & Automation Champion the use of AI and automation to transform both the customer and employee experience. Examples include: AI-enabled customer support Intelligent ticket routing and case management Automated onboarding workflows Digital customer education Self-service knowledge management Customer health monitoring Predictive churn identification AI-enhanced productivity tools for customer-facing teams Automated journeys that guide customers toward activation, adoption, and expansion Continuously evaluate emerging technologies that improve efficiency while maintaining a high-quality customer experience. Improve Customer Outcomes Own and improve key customer metrics, including: Customer Retention Gross Revenue Retention (GRR) Customer Health Time to Value Product Adoption Customer Satisfaction (CSAT) Net Promoter Score (NPS) Support SLAs Resolution Time Use customer insights and data to identify friction, improve onboarding, increase product adoption, and strengthen long-term customer relationships. Partner Cross-Functionally Serve as the voice of the customer across the business by partnering closely with: Product, Engineering, Sales, Marketing, Revenue Operations, Finance Translate customer feedback into actionable recommendations that influence product strategy, operational improvements, and customer experience initiatives. Partner with Product and Engineering to identify and address experience gaps within the product itself. Bring a holistic view of customer behavior, needs, and friction points to cross-functional planning and prioritization. Build for Scale Develop scalable systems, processes, and operating models that support rapid company growth. Create dashboards, forecasting models, workforce planning, and operational KPIs that provide visibility into customer performance and organizational health. Connect customer behavior, product usage, support interactions, onboarding progress, and retention signals to identify opportunities for improvement. Build feedback loops that translate customer insights into improvements across people, processes, product, and technology. Drive Holistic Customer Journey Optimization Map and measure key customer journeys to understand where customers experience friction, where they derive value, and where Roofr can proactively improve the experience. Prioritize journey improvements based on customer impact, business value, and scalability. Establish a culture of continuous experimentation and optimization, using data and customer feedback to test, learn, and improve the customer experience over time. What You’ll Bring to the Role: 10+ years of experience leading Customer Experience, Customer Success, Customer Operations, or Support organizations within a B2B SaaS company. 5+ years leading multiple customer-facing functions through managers and senior leaders. Experience supporting SMB customers in a Product-Led Growth (PLG) and/or Product-Led Sales (PLS) environment. Demonstrated success improving customer retention, customer satisfaction, and operational efficiency. Experience implementing AI and automation to improve customer outcomes and team productivity. Strong understanding of onboarding, customer support, customer lifecycle management, and digital customer engagement. Experience owning or optimizing end-to-end customer journeys across multiple customer-facing functions and touchpoints. Proven ability to build scalable processes and high-performing teams in high-growth environments. Strong analytical and data-driven decision-making skills. Exceptional executive presence and cross-functional leadership. Who You Are: Awareness that strategic clarity comes from a deep understanding of customers, products, teams and processes. You become decisive through deliberate learning and bring a growth mindset to every role. Experience scaling a Customer Experience organization and innovating to solve problems. Experience partnering closely with Product and Engineering to improve customer adoption and product usability. You think beyond individual functions and see the customer experience as one connected journey rather than a series of departmental handoffs. You naturally look for friction across the customer lifecycle and bring teams together to solve the underlying problem. You are deeply customer-centric and use a combination of qualitative feedback, behavioral data, and business metrics to understand what customers need and where the experience can improve. Familiarity with platforms such as Intercom, Gainsight, Salesforce, HubSpot, Gong, or similar customer technologies. Experience designing digital-first customer journeys and self-service customer experiences. Strong understanding of SaaS metrics including GRR, churn, customer health, adoption, and customer lifetime value. Success in Your First 12 Months Establish a unified Customer Experience strategy across Support, Onboarding, and Retention. Map and establish a clear view of the end-to-end customer journey, including key moments that matter, friction points, and opportunities for optimization. Reduce customer effort by implementing AI-enabled support and automation. Improve onboarding efficiency and accelerate customer time-to-value. Increase product adoption and customer engagement. Improve customer retention and satisfaction metrics. Establish measurable customer journey KPIs and feedback loops that enable continuous optimization. Build scalable operating processes and dashboards that support Roofr’s continued growth. Strengthen cross-functional partnerships that elevate the voice of the customer throughout the organization. Our compensation ranges are built using multiple market benchmarks and reflect both the scope of the role and current market data. While many hires fall within the beginning to midpoint of the band to allow for growth over time, we tailor offers based on each candidate’s experience, seniority, and demonstrated impact. 🏠 What we offer (US + Canada) When you join our team, you’re not just accepting a job. You’re making a career move. Here’s how we’ll support you in doing some of the most impactful work of your career: 🏝️ Vacation/Paid Time Off: 1st week of employment is mandatory PTO! Start your journey with Roofr by decompressing and recharging - we will see you in week 2! 1 Friday off per month (we call those our laundry days!) Company wide paid shutdown for the week between Christmas and New Years Flexible time off 80% employer-paid benefits in the U.S. and 100% employer-paid premiums for Extended Healthcare and Dental in Canada RRSP/401k match Generous Parental Leave policy 🤝 Perks: We host an annual company retreat with great team building activities Ample learning and development opportunities to continue growing your career Home office setup stipend Internet and phone allowance Remote first culture Weekly Friday paydays! 🤖 AI Notice At Roofr, we’re big fans of AI. It helps us write job descriptions that don’t put you to sleep, takes notes during interviews so we can actually listen, and even helps us track down awesome humans like you. Feel free to use AI to prep, research, or get pumped up for your interview (we see you, ChatGPT power users 👀). But when it’s time to chat, we’d love to meet you, not your AI alter ego. Bring your real, unfiltered self, we promise we will too. And don’t worry, a real, live human is behind every part of our process. Every application is reviewed by a real person, and you’ll always speak with real humans throughout the interview process. No bots, just good people ☺️ ⚠️ Important Notice We’ve been made aware of an individual impersonating Roofr using a fraudulent domain: roofrr.com (note the extra “r”). Our company takes the security and privacy of job applicants very seriously. We will never ask for payment, bank details, or personal financial information as part of the application process. All our legitimate job postings can be found on our official career site. Please be cautious of job offers that come from non-company email addresses, instant messaging platforms, or unsolicited calls. To ensure your application is legitimate, please apply directly through our official careers page: https://roofr.com/careers. If you receive any suspicious messages or have questions, reach out to us at talent@roofr.com . Your safety and security are important to us — thank you for your vigilance! Roofr is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to equal employment opportunity in the workplace regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or veteran status.

items.description: Adventure is our Culture. Join a team that celebrates a lifestyle as bold as the terrain we love. At Backcountry, we are rooted in adventure, recognition, and wellbeing on and off the mountain. We spotlight employee stories, celebrate milestones, and offer exclusive outdoor perks. Whether you are at HQ, in a retail store, or remote, you will be part of a team that thrives on energy, exploration, and connection. Reports to: Senior Vice President, Marketing Location: Toronto (Hybrid); All other Canada (Remote) About the Role: Backcountry is looking for a VP of Performance Marketing to own the paid media P&L and multi-year strategy across the full brand family: backcountry.com, competitivecyclist.com, steepandcheap.com, and biketiresdirect.com. This role sits on Backcountry’s marketing leadership team and is accountable for translating company revenue and margin targets into a paid media investment plan that delivers against incrementality, LTV, and blended CAC goals. As Vice President, Performance Marketing , you will set channel and budget allocation strategy, build the team and agency bench to execute it, and partner closely with Creative, Merchandising, and eCommerce leadership to ensure paid investment, assortment, and site experience reinforce each other. Success in the first year means establishing the multi-year roadmap, building the right org structure, and demonstrating measurable improvement in media efficiency across the portfolio. This is a lean team. You will own a lot, move fast, and make decisions with full end-to-end responsibility. What You’ll Do: Performance Marketing Strategy Own the performance marketing P&L and multi-year strategy across all four Backcountry banners, spanning paid search, paid social, shopping/feed, display, affiliate, video/TV, and emerging channels. Set channel and budget allocation based on incrementality, LTV, and blended CAC targets, and defend those trade-offs to the executive team. Translate company revenue and margin targets into a multi-year paid media investment plan. Build repeatable playbooks for launches, promotions, and seasonal peaks that scale across the brand portfolio. Champion a continuous A/B and multivariate testing culture across creative, landing pages, and audience targeting, turning results into scaled learnings. Track competitor activity and market trends across the outdoor and active lifestyle space to identify new channels, formats, and positioning opportunities. Team Leadership and Organization Build and lead a team of performance marketing leaders and specialists, including a Senior Director of Performance Marketing, plus supporting agencies. Set operating standards for testing velocity, reporting rigor, and channel expertise, and hold your leadership team accountable to them. Stay close enough to the numbers and the work to catch problems early, coach through them, and step in directly when needed. Hold agency partners accountable to performance benchmarks, media efficiency, and clear scopes of work. Own new channel expansion with hands-on execution of campaigns in emerging channels. Drive adoption and demonstrated use of AI and automation tools across the team to improve decisions, increase output, and free up time for high-value work. Executive and Cross-Functional Leadership Sit on Backcountry’s marketing leadership team and represent performance marketing in company-level strategy and planning. Partner with Creative to ensure ad concepts and assets are built for performance from the start. Partner with Merchandising to align paid spend with inventory, margin, and assortment priorities. Partner with eCommerce, Product, and Web Development to ensure landing pages, site experience, and conversion funnels support paid traffic quality. Report to the executive team on channel performance, budget efficiency, and growth opportunities, translating performance data into clear commercial recommendations. Flag risks and opportunities early, and bring solutions rather than just problems. Required Qualifications: Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Business, or a related field; advanced degree a plus. 12+ years of experience in performance marketing or paid media, including 5+ years leading managers or team leads, not just individual contributors. Proven ownership of a paid media budget spanning multiple channels (search, social, shopping/feed, display) at a scale consistent with a multi-brand or multi-hundred-million-dollar revenue business. Track record of owning performance marketing across multiple brands or business units simultaneously. Strong command of performance marketing economics: CAC, LTV, incrementality, marginal ROAS, and blended efficiency. Demonstrated ability to influence and align Creative, Merchandising, eCommerce, and executive stakeholders without direct authority over their teams. Proven experience building and leading teams of leaders, and managing agency relationships at scale. Strong executive presence and communication skills, with experience reporting directly to the C-suite or serving on a leadership team. Demonstrated experience using AI and automation tools to improve decisions, increase output, or improve team efficiency. Hands-on fluency with major ad platforms (Google Ads, Meta Ads Manager) and analytics/reporting tools (Google Analytics, Tableau or Looker Studio), even if day-to-day execution sits with the team. Preferred Qualifications: Experience in outdoor, sporting goods, cycling, or active lifestyle ecommerce. Experience with multi-brand or multi-site paid media management (shared team supporting several storefronts). Why Join: The people who do best here are builders. They take ownership, move fast, and want to see the direct impact of their work. Executive Access: Work directly with C-suite leadership and brand executives, representing performance marketing at the highest level of the organization. Leadership Opportunity: Build your team from the ground up across a portfolio of four brands, shaping both the org structure and the strategy it executes. Portfolio-Level Ownership: Own the paid media P&L across all Backcountry banners — set multi-year strategy and see the commercial results of your decisions. Competitive Benefits (US): Paid time off policies, 401(k) match, medical/dental/vision and a variety of supplemental policies, and employee discounts across our portfolio of brands. Competitive Benefits (Canada): Paid time off policies, RRSP match, medical, dental, and vision coverage, a variety of supplemental benefit options, and employee discounts across our portfolio of brands. Interview Process: Recruiter Screen - A 45-minute conversation with our recruiting team to align on the role, your background, and what you are looking for. Hiring Manager Interview - A deeper conversation focused on performance marketing strategy, team leadership philosophy, and portfolio-level P&L ownership. Panel Interview - Discussion with cross-functional leaders from Creative, Merchandising, and eCommerce to assess strategic alignment and collaboration approach. Executive Interview - Conversation with senior executive leadership on vision, culture fit, and long-term strategic direction. In-Person Interview - We’d like to meet you at our Salt Lake City office. Details and logistics will be arranged with your recruiter. Reference Checks - Conducted in parallel with the final stages where possible. Offer - We move quickly for the right candidate. Interview process is subject to change. Any updates will be communicated promptly and clearly. CSC Generation is an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. The CSC Generation family of brands is committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities in our job application procedures. If you need assistance or accommodation due to a disability, please contact [email protected]. For Ontario applicants, please note that this posting is for an existing vacancy. We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

The Marketing Special
items.description: Marketing Specialist EnergyHub empowers utilities and their customers to create a clean, distributed energy future. We accomplish this through innovative software and program management solutions that harness millions of distributed energy resources, enabling utilities to support more renewables and rely less on fossil energy. The Marketing Specialist will be responsible for partnering with our utility clients to execute digital and traditional marketing campaigns that drive end-user enrollment in our residential demand response programs. This is an outstanding opportunity to apply marketing and project management skills while contributing to an energy-focused enterprise software company. Responsibilities Partner with our utility clients to drive end-user enrollment in demand response programs Build relationships with utility client counterparts and secure buy-in for key marketing initiatives Support net service revenue growth by positioning marketing services to clients based on program needs and objectives Present program marketing strategies, project plans and insights to utility clients Evangelize program marketing best practices that enable utilities to rapidly and efficiently grow enrollments Partner with the client success team to disseminate program marketing best practices Help ensure consistent marketing messaging across utility, OEM partner and EnergyHub-owned marketing experiences Develop knowledge base content and marketing case studies that clients can use to improve program marketing outcomes Create, edit, and maintain marketing materials on behalf of utility clients across various platforms, including websites, social media, and email Other duties as assigned Skills/Qualifications 3-4 years of B2C acquisition marketing experience Excellent communication skills, storytelling skills and ability to distill complex concepts into key takeaways for clients General knowledge of marketing tactics, including SEO, email marketing, CRO, and social media Highly organized, with an ability to manage multiple projects, deadlines and budgets Data-driven mindset with an affinity for Excel and Google Analytics Informed opinions on marketing copy, design and UX best practices Experience with data visualization tools Energy industry knowledge is a plus, or a track record of rapidly acquiring domain knowledge in a similarly complex vertical Curiosity and enthusiasm about learning new things and building new relationships Please note that sponsorship of new applicants for employment authorization, or any other immigration-related support, is not available for this position at this time. Why work for EnergyHub? Collaborate with outstanding people: Our employees work hard, do great work, and enjoy collaborating and learning from each other. Make an immediate impact: New employees can expect to be given real responsibility for bringing new technologies to the marketplace. You are empowered to perform as soon as you join the team! Gain well rounded experience: EnergyHub offers a diverse and dynamic environment where you will get the chance to work directly with executives and develop expertise across multiple areas of the business. Work with the latest technologies: You’ll gain exposure to a broad spectrum of IoT, SaaS and machine learning obstacles, including distributed fault-tolerance, device control optimization, and process modeling to support scalable interaction with disparate downstream APIs. Be part of something important: Help create the future of how energy is produced and consumed. Make a positive impact on our climate. About EnergyHub EnergyHub empowers utilities and their customers to create a clean, distributed energy future. We help consumers turn their smart thermostats, EVs, batteries, and other products into virtual power plants that keep the grid stable and enable higher penetration of solar and wind power. To learn more, visit energyhub.com. Company Benefits EnergyHub offers a generous benefits package including 100% paid medical for employees and a 401(k) with employer match. We offer a casual environment, the flexibility to set your own schedule, a fully stocked fridge and pantry, free Citi Bike membership, secure bike rack, gym subsidy, paid parental leave, and an education assistance program. EnergyHub is an Equal Opportunity Employer EOE, Including Disability/Vets. Reasonable accommodations are available for individuals with disabilities throughout the application process. If you are a person with a disability needing assistance with the application process, please contact accommodations.apply@energyhub.net. In connection with your application, we collect information that identifies, reasonably relates to or describes you (“Personal Information”). The categories of Personal Information that we may collect include your name, government-issued identification number(s), email address, mailing address, other contact information, emergency contact information, employment history, educational history, and demographic information. We collect and use those categories of Personal Information about you for human resources and other business management purposes, including identifying and evaluating you as a candidate for potential or future employment or future positions, recordkeeping in relation to recruiting and hiring, conducting analytics, and ensuring compliance with applicable legal requirements and Company policies. By submitting your application, you acknowledge that we may retain some of the personal data that you provide in your application for our internal operations such as managing our recruitment system and ensuring that we comply with labor laws and regulations even after we have made our employment decision. Notice To Third Party Agencies: EnergyHub understands the value of professional recruiting services. However, we are not accepting resumes from recruiters or employment agencies for this position. In the event we receive a resume or candidate referral for this position from a third-party recruiter or agency without a previously signed agreement, we reserve the right to pursue and hire those candidate(s) without any financial obligation to you. The base salary range of this opportunity is listed below and is determined within a range based on factors including qualifications, location and experience. This allows opportunity for growth and development within the role. The base salary offered is part of a total compensation package. Base Salary Range $60,000—$77,000 USD

items.title: Senior Product Engineer (Fullstack)
items.location: Europe, UK, Germany, France, European timezones
items.summary: About Clipster Clipster is where brands and creators connect to turn views into profits. Clippers (Creators) clip, remix, and post branded content on TikTok, YouTube, Instagram, X, and beyond — earning money for every view they deliver. Brands get a significantly better influencer marketing experience thanks to scale, simplicity, and reliable performance tracking. We started as an influencer marketing agency. While clients loved our results, delivering them was a pain. So we started automating everything we did — and it paid off. 2025 was a great year for us: We launched our platform in early 2025 We grew our team to 35 members We scaled from 0 to more than 100,000 creators and paid out more than $5M to them We acquired more than 120 clients solely through word of mouth. Our growth has been 100% organic We ran campaigns for companies such as Telegram, UFC, Universal Music Group and artists such as Elton John, Ed Sheeran, Playboi Carti, and Kendrick Lamar We're profitable and have secured our first investor The role We are looking for a Backend-Heavy Senior Engineer who isn't afraid to touch the full stack. While your primary domain will be our Golang services and distributed architecture, you are a "Product Engineer" at heart — meaning you understand the "why" behind the code and can jump into the React/Next.js frontend whenever it's the shortest path to delivering value. The mindset we hire for Intensity & Grit — You run toward hard problems and stay until they are solved. Ambitious Simplification — You have the intelligence to solve complex problems and the wisdom to choose the simplest solution. Ownership & Mission Alignment — You don't "close tickets"; you ship outcomes. You care about the creator economy as much as we do. AI Readiness — You leverage modern tools to multiply your output and keep us at the cutting edge. Humility & Collaboration — You are a high-bandwidth communicator who mentors others and leaves your ego at the door. Your technical toolkit Core Backend — 5+ years of experience, with at least 3+ years of mastery in Golang. Comfortable with high-performance distributed systems. Fullstack Versatility — Backend is your home, but you have the skills to navigate and contribute to a React/Next.js frontend. Infrastructure & Data — Deep knowledge of PostgreSQL, Redis, and ideally GCP. Architectural Mindset — You move seamlessly from system design to shipping production-ready code. Clean code, test coverage, and documentation are your tools for maintaining velocity. Bonus points Experience with payment systems (we handle around $1M in monthly payouts). Event-driven architectures and real-time data processing. Why Clipster Total ownership - Join a lean tech team of fewer than 15 people. What you build today, millions will use tomorrow. Remote & async - Work where you are most effective. We only ask for availability during our core hours (10am – 2pm UTC+2). Zero bureaucracy - No endless meetings. We value documentation, Slack, and Loom for high-bandwidth, low-noise collaboration. Next steps Discovery call - a brief chat with our recruiter. Pair programming - a hands-on session with one of our engineers. System design - a discussion about an architectural problem, based on our day-to-day problems. Engineering excellence discussion. Final meet - chat with our Founder and PM to talk mission and values.

items.title: Global Treasury Analyst
items.summary: Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders…
items.description: Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1000+ colleagues in 70+ countries and very few roles based in offices. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution. The company is founder led, profitable and growing. We are hiring a Global Treasury Analyst to optimize our cash returns, determine the appropriate mix of currency holdings, and manage bank credit risk. They will forecast opex and capex liquidity requirements and model free cash flow under a range of business scenarios to ensure an optimal return on cash. We are an organisation that hires globally and pays salaries in many local currencies. Our customers are global but products are typically priced in USD. We are largely paid in advance for our services, so this role is primarily focused on risk-free yield optimization and currency planning to manage exchange rate risk. This senior role will interact with executives, financial planning and analysis, accounting, legal and our external auditors and advisors. They may also assist with equity plan administration. As a finance team, we hunt for new and innovative ways to help Canonical invest for the future while limiting volatility and material surprises, and are excited to grow the team to address this specialist domain. This role will report to the CFO. Key responsibilities Analyse, forecast and manage global cash positions and liquidity in multiple currencies for multiple entities Forecast a range of business scenarios to optimize yield and operating efficiency Recommend actions to manage foreign currency exposure and risk Manage bank credit risk, transaction execution, and relationships Ensure appropriate controls are in place around cash and investment strategy Identify process and system improvements for cash flow forecasting Prepare and present treasury reports, documents and proposed strategies to management Collaborate with accounting in the management of inter-company transactions and balances Lead technology implementations including a treasury management system Ensure compliance with SOX controls, FBAR, FATCA, and related regulations What we are looking for in you An exceptional academic track record from both high school and university Undergraduate degree in business, finance, economics or other quantitative field CTP, CFA, or equivalent certification in Treasury or Analysis Relevant professional experience in a global treasury function A passion for technology and a drive to work with motivated colleagues Professional written and spoken English and excellent presentation skills Excellent interpersonal skills, curiosity, flexibility, and accountability Thoughtfulness and self-motivation Result-oriented, with a personal drive to meet commitments A track record of going above-and-beyond expectations Ability to travel twice a year, for company events up to two weeks long Additional skills that you might also bring Leadership ability Software or tech industry experience Public company finance and reporting experience Experience managing transfer agents and/or administering employee equity plans a plus MBA or equivalent combination of professional experience and certifications Experience with Business Intelligence reporting, CRM, and ERP systems What we offer you We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognise outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus or commission. We provide all team members with additional benefits, which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally. Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year Annual compensation review Recognition rewards Annual holiday leave Maternity and paternity leave Employee Assistance Programme Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues Priority Pass, and travel upgrades for long haul company events About Canonical Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open source projects and the platform for AI, IoT and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence - in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since its inception in 2004.​ Working here is a step into the future, and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game. Canonical is an equal opportunity employer We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration. #LI-remote

items.description: Work Schedule Standard (Mon-Fri) Environmental Conditions Office Job Description Senior Sales Director, Safety, Security & Radiation Detection EMEA Position Summary The Senior Sales Manager, Safety, Security & Radiation Detection EMEA is responsible for leading the commercial strategy, sales execution, channel management, and business growth across Europe, the Middle East, and Africa. This role provides strategic and operational leadership for the Safety, Security, and Radiation Detection portfolio, ensuring sustainable revenue growth, market share expansion, customer satisfaction, and profitability throughout the region. The position has full responsibility for regional sales performance, distributor network optimization, key account management, forecasting accuracy, business planning, and the development of high-performing sales teams. The incumbent will collaborate closely with global commercial leadership, product management, marketing, service, operations, and channel partners to drive business success and support Thermo Fisher Scientific's mission of making the world healthier, cleaner, and safer and will report to the Director MCS EMEA Key Responsibilities Commercial Leadership Develop and execute the regional commercial strategy for Safety, Security, and Radiation Detection across EMEA. Deliver or exceed annual revenue, order booking, profitability, and market share objectives. Establish regional growth initiatives aligned with corporate objectives and long-term business plans. Identify emerging market opportunities and develop expansion strategies across government, defense, homeland security, customs, critical infrastructure, transportation, nuclear, and industrial sectors. Lead regional pricing strategies and commercial negotiations to maximize profitability and competitive positioning. Sales Management Lead, coach, and develop Regional Sales Managers and commercial team members across EMEA. Establish clear performance objectives and accountability measures for direct and indirect reports. Drive a high-performance sales culture focused on customer engagement, operational excellence, and growth. Monitor sales performance, pipeline health, forecasting accuracy, and execution against strategic objectives. Ensure effective territory management and resource allocation across the region. Channel & Distributor Management Manage and optimize the regional distributor network. Evaluate distributor performance and implement improvement plans where required. Recruit, develop, and train new distributors to support strategic growth objectives. Identify opportunities to streamline channel structures and improve market coverage. Ensure distributors maintain appropriate product knowledge, compliance standards, and customer support capabilities. Strategic Account Management Develop executive-level relationships with key customers, government agencies, strategic accounts, and channel partners. Lead commercial negotiations for complex and high-value opportunities. Support global account initiatives and coordinate multi-country opportunities. Manage critical customer escalations and ensure timely resolution of business issues. Drive customer retention and long-term partnership development. Business Planning & Forecasting Develop and execute annual regional business plans. Own forecast accuracy, pipeline management, and sales reporting. Utilize CRM tools to manage opportunities, customer segmentation, and business intelligence. Analyze market trends, competitive activity, and customer requirements to support decision-making. Present business reviews and growth plans to executive leadership. Cross-Functional Leadership Collaborate with Product Management, Marketing, Service, Operations, Finance, Regulatory Affairs, and Engineering teams. Lead regional implementation of new product launches and commercial initiatives. Participate in global strategic projects and business transformation initiatives. Support mergers, acquisitions, integrations, and organizational change activities where applicable. Customer Experience & Operational Excellence Ensure customer satisfaction objectives are consistently achieved or exceeded. Drive continuous improvement initiatives across commercial processes. Promote a customer-centric culture throughout the organization. Support resolution of complex service, technical, and commercial issues. Ensure compliance with all company policies, industry regulations, and ethical business practices. Industry Representation Represent Thermo Fisher Scientific at industry conferences, trade shows, workshops, and government forums. Build strategic relationships with industry leaders, regulatory authorities, and key stakeholders. Act as a recognized commercial leader within the Safety, Security, and Radiation Detection markets. Minimum Qualifications Education Bachelor's degree in Business, Engineering, Science, Technology, or related discipline. MBA or advanced business qualification preferred. 5 years experience in Military & Radiation business IS MANDATORY TO BE ELIGIBLE Experience 10+ years of progressive commercial leadership experience within industrial, analytical instrumentation, safety, security, defense, radiation detection, homeland security, or related technology markets. Demonstrated success managing large, geographically dispersed sales organizations. Proven experience managing distributor and channel partner networks across EMEA. Strong background in strategic account management and complex sales negotiations. Experience leading multicultural teams across multiple countries and regions. Leadership Competencies Strategic thinking and business acumen. Executive presence and stakeholder management. Change management and organizational leadership. Talent development and coaching. Financial and commercial decision-making. People management skills to manage a team of 13 people Customer-centric leadership. Cross-functional collaboration and influence. Technical & Commercial Skills Sales forecasting and pipeline management. CRM proficiency (Salesforce preferred). Contract negotiation and commercial management. Business planning and financial analysis. Market development and channel strategy. Government and institutional sales experience preferred. Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) Revenue and order booking attainment. Regional profitability and margin growth. Forecast accuracy. Distributor performance and productivity. Market share expansion. Customer satisfaction and retention. Strategic account growth. Team engagement and development. Pipeline growth and conversion rates. Successful execution of regional business plans. Travel Requirements Up to 50% international travel across Europe, Middle East, and Africa. Participation in customer visits, distributor meetings, industry events, leadership meetings, and strategic business reviews. Reporting Structure Reports To: MCS EMEA Director Direct Reports: Regional Sales Managers and Channel Managers Strategic Business Development Indirect Reports: Distributor and Channel Partner Organizations across EMEA

We provide a tech-enabled service where our dedicated team leverages proprietary software to eliminate the administrative burdens of manual invoice audits and costly billing errors. Our mission is to streamline this critical operation, freeing up employers, brokers, and carriers to focus on their strategic priorities. About the Role: Compensation - $140,000 - $180,000The Director of Operations is responsible for overseeing and optimizing day-to-day business operations across the organization, with direct oversight of the Implementation, Client Services, and Data Operations functions. This role ensures operational efficiency, scalability, and alignment with company goals by driving process improvements, managing cross-functional workflows, and supporting team performance across these core business functions. The Director of Operations partners closely with executive leadership to translate strategic priorities into actionable plans, while maintaining a strong focus on execution, quality, and continuous improvement. This is a director level, supervisory role that guides the managers leading each function, rather than performing hands on work within them. Reports to: Chief Operating Officer Key Responsibilities: Cross-Functional Oversight Oversee daily operations across core functional areas, including Implementation, Client Services, and Data Operations Provide leadership, coaching, and direction to the managers leading each of these functions Drive process standardization and optimization across teams to improve efficiency, accuracy, and scalability Establish, track, and analyze key performance indicators (KPIs) to measure operational and team performance across all three functions Ensure operational compliance with HIPAA and carrier and vendor data handling requirements across all functions overseen Implementation Oversight Provide strategic direction over the Implementation function, ensuring the team maintains technical excellence in EDI standards (including HIPAA 834), API integrations, and benefit administration platforms Partner with the Manager of Implementation to set priorities for process design, automation, and tooling that improve data exchange and issue resolution Ensure quality standards and escalation processes are in place for complex integration challenges Data Operations Oversight Provide strategic direction over the Data Operations function, ensuring accuracy and auditability across plan premium audits, billing data analysis, and Excel-based reconciliation processes Partner with the Manager of Data Operations to set standards for data quality, process automation, and tool development Guide the team's approach to identifying trends, anomalies, and discrepancies in billing data, ensuring consistent resolution, documentation, and training for junior team members Client Services Oversight Partner with the Manager of Client Services to ensure a consistent, high-quality client experience across all touchpoints Support escalation management for complex or high-impact client issues Ensure alignment between Client Services and the other operational functions on shared priorities Strategic & Cross-Functional Leadership Partner with executive leadership to operationalize company goals and strategic initiatives Identify gaps in processes, systems, and workflows across functions, and implement solutions to improve outcomes Lead resource planning and capacity management to support business growth and delivery timelines Collaborate cross-functionally with Sales, Product, and Engineering to ensure alignment on priorities, timelines, and expectations Serve as a key operational partner to Product, ensuring new features and enhancements are effectively integrated into workflows and support scalable delivery Ensure consistent adoption and effective use of operational tools and systems Maintain high standards of service delivery, quality, and client satisfaction Drive continuous improvement initiatives and foster a culture of accountability and performance Requirements 15+ years of experience in operations, business management, or a related field, including meaningful experience in benefits administration, EDI/API implementation, or billing and data operations 8+ years of experience leading teams and/or managing managers, ideally across multiple functional areas Strong ability to analyze processes, identify inefficiencies, and implement scalable solutions Experience working cross-functionally in a fast-paced, high-growth environment Excellent
