items.description: Sales and Marketing Headquarters: United States (Remote) Grafana Labs, the company behind the open observability cloud, is founded on the principles of open source, open standards, open ecosystems, and open culture. Grafana Cloud, our fully managed observability platform, is flexible and built for scale. With Grafana Cloud's actually useful AI, organizations can see, understand, and act on all their disparate data to move at the speed of their ambitions. Today, more than 35 million users and 7,000+ customers – including Anthropic, Bloomberg, NVIDIA, Microsoft, and Salesforce – trust Grafana Labs to ensure reliability of their applications and systems, resolve incidents quickly, and optimize their telemetry to reduce noise and cost. We are a 100% remote company with 1,600+ team members across 40+ countries, and we’re backed by leading investors including Lightspeed Venture Partners, Sequoia Capital, GIC, Coatue, J.P. Morgan, CapitalG, and Lead Edge Capital. Learn more at grafana.com and follow us on LinkedIn and X . We’re scaling fast and staying true to what makes us different: an open-source legacy, a global collaborative culture, and a passion for meaningful work. Our team thrives in an innovation-driven environment where transparency, autonomy, and trust fuel everything we do. You may not meet every requirement, and that’s okay. If this role excites you, we’d love you to raise your hand for what could be a truly career-defining opportunity. The Opportunity Grafana's Demand Generation team is responsible for creating and accelerating pipeline across the full customer journey — from first touch through expansion. We run a modern, AI-forward operation: lifecycle email programs driven by an AI engine, territory-level buying signals surfaced directly to sales leaders, and agentic workflows that handle work that used to take teams of specialists. We're hiring a Demand Generation Program Manager — a generalist who can own programs across channels and audiences, with a first focus on our existing-customer motion: driving expansion and cross-sell demand within accounts that already use Grafana. This is one of the biggest growth opportunities in the business and one of the least-covered by traditional demand gen. This is not a "run the playbook" role. We expect this person to build with AI as a default — designing agentic workflows that scale programs beyond what headcount alone could, and pushing the team forward on how demand gen should operate in 2026 and beyond. You'd be joining a demand gen team that is genuinely rebuilding how the function works — where AI agents run real production programs, and where the people on the team design the machine rather than turn the crank. If you want to define what a demand gen career looks like in the agentic era, this is the seat to do it from. What You'll Be Doing Own customer lifecycle demand gen. Build and run programs that create demand inside our existing customer base — expansion, cross-sell, and adoption plays across email, in-app, web, and field channels, in partnership with sales and customer teams. Work across channels, not in one. Support and strengthen programs across paid, email, events, web, and outbound as team priorities shift. You'll be the person who can step into any channel and make the program better. Build agentic workflows. Use AI tools (Claude Code, agents, internal AI infrastructure) to automate program execution — audience building, content generation, signal detection, campaign QA — and treat automation as a first-class deliverable, not a side project. Connect programs to the sales motion. Translate marketing signals into actions sellers actually take: account coverage, buying signals, campaign follow-up. Partner directly with sales leadership on what's working. Measure what matters. Instrument your programs, report on pipeline impact honestly, and kill what isn't working. What Makes You a Great Fit 5+ years in demand generation, growth marketing, or lifecycle marketing at a B2B software company (open source / developer-focused a plus). Proven range: you've run programs in at least two or three channels (email/lifecycle, paid, events, web, outbound) and can point to pipeline results in each. Experience marketing to existing customers — expansion, cross-sell, or customer lifecycle programs — not just net-new acquisition. Hands-on with AI in your actual work: you've built automations or agentic workflows (or are visibly on that path), and you think about AI as leverage, not a threat or a buzzword. Comfortable with data: you can pull your own numbers, sanity-check them, and build a program readout a VP would trust. Strong program management fundamentals — you ship on time, communicate proactively, and work well with sales, product marketing, and ops without needing a coordinator. Bonus Points For Experience with PLG or product-led motions alongside sales-led ones. Familiarity with the observability / monitoring / open source ecosystem. You've worked in Marketo, Salesforce, and a modern data stack (BigQuery or similar). You've written or shipped something public about AI in marketing operations. items.title: 1224SA - 377TEL | Project Accounting Specialist
items.summary: Telaid has been delivering technology deployment solutions to multi-site companies for over 37 years.
items.description: Telaid has been delivering technology deployment solutions to multi-site companies for over 37 years. We are a growing, privately held company looking for a dedicated Project Accounting Specialist to join our team. If you’re a detail-oriented finance professional who thrives in collaborative environments, loves improving processes, and is passionate about achieving financial goals, this opportunity is for you! Position Overview: As a Project Accounting Specialist , you will play a critical role in managing project finances, ensuring accuracy in billing and reporting, and supporting internal teams and external clients. This role is integral to Telaid’s commitment to reducing the time, task, risk, and cost of technology deployments. Key Responsibilities: Collaborate with Project Managers to gather timely and accurate information for monthly billings. Input project budgets and billing information into financial systems proactively. Generate invoices using various software and resolve billing-related issues with customers. Apply payments to customer accounts and reconcile discrepancies. Review credit reports for new customers to establish credit limits. Prepare periodic reports using accounting software. Participate in regular project review meetings to analyze financial performance and trends. Research and respond to inquiries from the Project Management Team regarding project costs and revenues. Develop project financial templates and support client onboarding to ensure smooth submission processes. Perform client submission verifications and address issues related to aging balances, escalating when necessary. Collaborate with cross-functional teams to resolve billing and account-related discrepancies. Qualifications: High School Diploma or equivalent (Associate’s or Bachelor’s degree preferred). Minimum of 2 years of experience in billing and collections. Strong communication, problem-solving, and analytical skills. Detail-oriented with the ability to work independently in a fast-paced, multitasking environment. Proficiency in MS Office, particularly Excel. Experience with Crystal Reports and Microsoft Power BI is a plus. Familiarity with ERP systems and project accounting environments is desirable. Why Join Telaid? Be part of a company that values collaboration, innovation, and process improvement. Enjoy the flexibility of working remotely while contributing to impactful technology deployment projects. Work with a supportive team and develop your skills in a dynamic, growth-oriented environment. If you’re ready to make a difference and grow your career with Telaid, we’d love to hear from you! Apply today to join our mission of delivering excellence in technology deployments. Originally posted on Himalayas

items.description: Our client is an international product-based IT company specializing in the iGaming industry, with its own affiliate program and in-house products in online casino, betting, and poker. The company has been successfully operating for more than 12 years, building strong positions in the CIS market while continuing global growth and expansion. We are currently looking for an Media Buyer TG. 📋 Key responsibilities and your contribution: Build and develop the Telegram Ads traffic source from scratch; Launch, test, optimize, and scale profitable advertising campaigns; Research and validate new approaches, creatives, funnels, and traffic strategies; Analyze campaign performance and continuously improve key metrics; Work closely with product, analytics, design, and marketing teams; Manage advertising budgets efficiently while maintaining profitability; Build a knowledge base of successful approaches and continuously optimize workflows; Monitor Telegram Ads updates, market trends, and competitor activities; Play a key role in growing the new direction with the opportunity to become a Team Lead as the team expands. 📚 Your qualifications: 3+ years of experience in media buying, including at least 1 year of hands-on experience with Telegram Ads; Proven experience in Gambling/iGaming traffic acquisition; Strong understanding of the Telegram Ads ecosystem, traffic sources, and campaign optimization; Experience launching, testing, and scaling campaigns from scratch; Ability to analyze key performance metrics (ROI, CPA, CR, CTR, CPM, PnL) and make data-driven decisions; Experience working with analytics and tracking tools (Keitaro, Binom, Voluum, Google Sheets, Power BI, etc.); Experience managing monthly advertising budgets starting from $50K; Understanding of affiliate offers, agency accounts, and Telegram Ads infrastructure; Strong analytical mindset and willingness to experiment with new approaches; Ability to work independently, take ownership, and build processes from the ground up. ➕ Nice to have: Experience working with CIS GEOs; Experience building Telegram funnels using bots, mini apps, or custom landing flows; Existing contacts with Telegram Ads agencies or account providers; Experience working with both product and affiliate traffic; Knowledge of automation tools, scripts, or AI solutions for campaign optimization; Experience mentoring teammates or leading traffic initiatives. Benefits: ⭐ Time Off & Recovery: 20 working days of fully paid annual leave, fully paid sick leave, and public holidays off according to company policy. ⭐ Health & Wellness: A flexible Benefits cafeteria that allows you to choose the perks that fit you best, with options including medical support, regular check-ups, mental health services, or gym access. ⭐ Education & Development: Internal and external training, industry events, language courses, and professional service subscriptions. ⭐ Workspace & Tech: All necessary corporate equipment provided, the flexibility to work fully remotely, and premium digital tools to enhance performance (e.g., AI tools, ChatGPT Plus). ⭐ Work Environment & Perks: Holiday bonuses, gifts for special occasions, paid business trips, and team events. items.title: STAQ Director
items.summary: At EQT, you won't just do a job—you'll help shape our future.
items.description: At EQT, you won't just do a job—you'll help shape our future. Through Transparent Leadership, you'll work alongside leaders who value collaboration and ensure every voice is heard. Through Connected Impact, you'll see how your work influences critical business decisions and drives value across our operations. Through Supported Growth, you'll have opportunities to expand your skills through cross-functional collaboration, development opportunities, and career advancement. Join our Qrew! Position Objective The Director, STAQ leads the team responsible for EQT’s Special Project Case (SPC) pipeline — the “Innovation Engine” that turns business ideas into delivered technology and process improvements. The role owns intake, prioritization, scoping, solution-architecture governance, and value realization across a portfolio that serves every EQT business department. The ideal candidate is a delivery-minded leader who is comfortable with technical projects and oil & gas business applications, sets clear priorities against finite capacity, and builds a high-performing team and a culture of continuous improvement. Essential Duties Strategy & portfolio: Develop and maintain the STAQ strategy — project prioritization frameworks, value-realization tracking, and portfolio management — so EQT focuses on its highest-value initiatives. Pipeline ownership: Own the SPC pipeline end to end — intake, triage, scoping, prioritization, development hand-off to IT delivery teams, documentation, and post-implementation lookback. Cross-functional governance: Lead recurring cross-functional Special Project Reviews with business departments and internal team standups and architecture-collaboration sessions to align priorities and unblock delivery. Architecture & quality: Govern solution architecture and data-quality standards so the pipeline stays reliable, fast, supported, valuable, and clean (the Innovation Engine scorecard). People leadership: Lead, coach, and develop the STAQ team (Business Process Operations Manager and Business Process Engineers); foster a culture of innovation, experimentation, and continuous improvement. Budget & capacity: Develop and manage the STAQ budget and capacity plan; balance incoming demand against the standing backlog and available staffing. Stakeholder alignment: Communicate with executive and cross-functional stakeholders to align department portfolios, delivery priorities, and enterprise strategy; steward STAQ’s knowledge base and operating standards. Continuous improvement: Research and evaluate emerging technologies (automation, analytics) for business applicability and pursue continuous improvement of the pipeline and its supporting infrastructure. Minimum Qualifications 8+ years of combined experience in technology delivery, business operations, and/or process improvement, including team leadership Bachelor’s degree, preferably in a technical or quantitative field (e.g., Engineering, Computer/Data Science, Information Systems, or Business). An engineering degree is beneficial but not required. Experience delivering technology programs or products from inception through delivery to post-launch. Demonstrated ability to gather requirements, define project scope, and translate business needs into technical solutions. Demonstrated understanding of data structures, analytics, and solution architecture (conceptual fluency required; hands-on engineering not required). Proven ability to coordinate, organize, lead, and develop teams, and to manage competing priorities across many stakeholders. Comfort working on technical projects and with oil & gas business applications, with a strong understanding of how the business works. Strong executive communication and stakeholder-management skills. Preferred Qualifications Experience developing or leading Salesforce-based business processes and custom solutions. Experience with data tools, pipelines, and analytics platforms (e.g., Power BI, Databricks). Engineering and/or operational experience in the oil & gas industry (beneficial, not required). Experience leading a portfolio, delivery, or business-process function. Familiarity with EQT’s “Way We Work” operating model (Programs, Utilities, Insights, Sessions, and Knowledge). Selected incumbent will be placed into the position that best suits their abilities and experience level. EQT Corporation and its subsidiaries is an Equal Opportunity Employer -- Disabilities/Veterans. Originally posted on Himalayas

Description Product Owner - Finance Systems & Projects Sobre a posição Buscamos um(a) Product Owner para atuar como elo entre as áreas de Finanças e Tecnologia, garantindo a estabilidade, evolução e melhoria contínua dos sistemas financeiros da organização. Este profissional será responsável por liderar a gestão de demandas, incidentes e melhorias sistêmicas, assegurando rápida resposta às necessidades do negócio, além de atuar na condução de projetos estratégicos de transformação e automação de processos financeiros. A posição exige forte interação com stakeholders de diversas áreas de finanças, capacidade de priorização em ambientes dinâmicos e habilidade para traduzir necessidades de negócio em soluções tecnológicas eficientes. Principais Responsabilidades Sustentação de Sistemas Financeiros Atuar como responsável funcional pelos sistemas de finanças, garantindo sua operação contínua e aderência às necessidades do negócio. Gerenciar e priorizar demandas, incidentes e problemas críticos, assegurando tratamento adequado dentro dos SLAs definidos. Conduzir análises de causa raiz e coordenar planos de ação para mitigação de recorrências. Atuar como principal ponto de contato entre as áreas de negócio e as equipes de TI para temas relacionados à sustentação. Avaliar impactos de mudanças sistêmicas nos processos financeiros e operacionais. Realizar acompanhamento contínuo da saúde dos sistemas, identificando riscos e oportunidades de melhoria. Gestão de Relacionamento com o Negócio Manter relacionamento próximo e constante com as áreas de Finanças. Conduzir reuniões recorrentes de alinhamento, priorização e acompanhamento das demandas. Levantar requisitos, mapear processos e traduzir necessidades de negócio para equipes técnicas. Garantir comunicação clara e permanente entre stakeholders, usuários-chave e times de tecnologia. Gestão de Projetos Liderar projetos de evolução sistêmica, automação e transformação digital para as áreas financeiras. Coordenar atividades desde a definição do escopo até implantação em produção. Elaborar cronogramas, planos de ação, análise de riscos e acompanhamento de entregas. Conduzir cerimônias de projeto e reuniões executivas de status. Apoiar processos de testes, homologação, treinamento e gestão da mudança. Gestão de Backlog e Priorização Manter backlog de melhorias e demandas atualizado e priorizado. Definir critérios de priorização considerando impacto financeiro, riscos regulatórios, experiência do usuário e valor para o negócio. Trabalhar junto às equipes de desenvolvimento para refinamento de requisitos e acompanhamento das entregas. Qualifications Conhecimento dos principais processos financeiros, incluindo: Contratação e Faturamento (Billing) Contas a Receber (Accounts Receivable) Revenue Recognition Cobrança e aplicações de recebimentos Controles financeiros e contábeis Inglês avançado obrigatório Sistemas e Ferramentas Gestão de backlog (Jira, Azure DevOps ou similares) Ferramentas de documentação (Confluence ou similares) Power BI e IA (desejável) Experiência com ERP, sistemas financeiros e integrações Metodologias Agile / Scrum Kanban Gestão de Projetos Competências Comportamentais Comunicação clara e objetiva Forte capacidade de priorização Senso de urgência Organização e gestão simultânea de múltiplas demandas Perfil colaborativo e orientado ao cliente interno Capacidade de negociação com stakeholders Visão de processos e resolução de problemas Facilidade para atuar em ambientes dinâmicos e com constante mudança de prioridades Diferenciais Experiência prévia em áreas de Finance Systems, Finance Transformation ou Product Ownership em Finanças. Conhecimento de processos O2C, P2P e R2R. Experiência em sustentação de aplicações corporativas críticas. Participação em projetos de implementação ou transformação de sistemas financeiros. items.description: Design Headquarters: Chicago, SEA, SF, NYC, US-Remote Who we are About Stripe Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies—from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups—use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone’s reach while doing the most important work of your career. About the team As Stripe continues to develop innovative products that serve businesses of all sizes, risk will increase in complexity and scale. The Industry Expansion Strategy team protects Stripe's business and mission by building the policies, frameworks, and practices that enable Stripe to support businesses in complex, highly regulated industries. As Stripe expands into new markets and products, we unlock revenue, advance trust, and set the standard for what responsible growth looks like at scale. What you’ll do Stripe's financial infrastructure only works if merchants can trust it—and that trust depends on us staying ahead of card network requirements. The Industry Expansion Strategy team owns that problem globally. As part of the team, you'll be the person who ensures our merchant portfolio stays compliant with Visa, Mastercard, and other card network rules as Stripe scales globally. This isn't a passive monitoring role. You'll work directly with Sales, merchants, card networks, and internal Risk and Compliance teams to catch issues early, fix them fast, and build processes that move Stripe ahead. We are looking for someone who is passionate about navigating ambiguity, enabling business growth while balancing risk, and is skilled at identifying ways to improve user experience. Responsibilities Own oversight of merchant risk management processes for Payment Facilitators, Marketplaces, and other Third-Party Agents and Servicers, including preparing merchants for card network registration, managing network reporting requirements, and conducting periodic reviews and user remediations Partner with internal teams to design compliance strategies that support Stripe's global expansion without creating major downstream risks Embed within first-line teams, particularly Sales and Product, to train sellers to develop the judgment to catch gaps and position Risk as a business enabler Build new processes and enhance existing processes to optimize for efficiency and automation, manage incoming non-compliance escalations from partners, and monitor our portfolio against rules and requirements Perform research and analysis to assess Stripe's current market position and develop and prioritize long-term strategic plans for future growth Challenge the status quo and provide multiple alternative solutions and key execution criteria Execute special projects and ad hoc analyses as initiatives, products, risks, and opportunities are constantly evolving Who you are We’re looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement. Minimum requirements 5+ years of professional experience in a related role in Payments or FinTech industries, including experience with card network compliance Familiarity with banking and money movement regulations, including KYC and KYB, AML OFAC compliance, and credit and fraud risk Experience overseeing design execution and delivery of highly strategic programs Proven ability to take complex issues and turn them into actionable next steps, hold others accountable, and meet deadlines Data-driven problem-solving skills, including the ability to distill complex, ambiguous regulatory issues into clear, concise, and reliable guidance for stakeholders and Stripe users Demonstrated track record of deriving insights from complex or technical problem spaces and evangelizing actionable product recommendations Strong stakeholder management skills and operating rigor, including the ability to take ownership, be accountable, and lead without formal authority to navigate ambiguity and solve problems with the end user in mind Entrepreneurial and curious mindset, including motivation to develop deep subject matter expertise and understanding of risk-based frameworks Strong operating rigor, executive presence, and presentation skills, including experience engaging with leadership Experience in a client-facing role managing relationships with large, global organizations Preferred Qualifications Strong desire to work in a fast-paced and innovative environment A strong understanding of Stripe's business and products and an ability to research and self-start To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/stripe-risk-strategist-card-network-compliance

items.summary: Superside is hiring a Creative Strategist, Performance Marketing to lead the strategic thinking behind our clients' highest-volume, highest-velocity creative programs. You'll sit at the intersection of data and creative, turning performance signals from paid social, OOH, and programmatic campaigns into sharp, testable creative direction — while acting as a trusted strategic partner to the clients whose business results depend on it. You'll run strategy across a portfolio of accounts at once, each producing a high volume of creative every month, and you'll be the person both the client and the creative team turn to when they need to know not just what to make next, but why.

items.description: About Zscaler Zscaler accelerates digital transformation to ensure our customers can be more agile, efficient, resilient, and secure. As an AI-forward enterprise , we are constantly pushing the envelope, leveraging the world’s largest security data lake to power our cloud-native Zero Trust Exchange platform. This innovation protects our customers from cyberattacks and data loss by securely connecting users, devices, and applications in any location. Here, impact in your role matters more than title and trust is built on results. We say, impact over activity. We seek innovators who actively use AI to amplify their impact and who thrive in an environment where we leverage intelligent systems to stay ahead of evolving threats. We believe in transparency and value constructive, honest debate —we’re focused on getting to the best ideas, faster. We build high-performing teams that can make an impact quickly and with high quality. To do this, we are building a culture of execution centered on customer obsession , collaboration, ownership, and accountability. We value high-impact, high-accountability with a sense of urgency where you’re enabled to do your best work and embrace your potential. If you’re driven by purpose, thrive on solving complex challenges, and want to be part of the team that’s helping to secure the AI age, we invite you to bring your talents to Zscaler and help shape the future of cybersecurity. Role We are looking for a Director, Business Operations, Customer Success to join our team. This is a Remote role reporting to the Sr. Director, Strategy & Operations.. This role is critical to supporting the global Customer Success organization, with a primary focus on Customer Support, Technical Success, and Professional Services. You will help stand up and lead a newly created Business Operations function, establishing the operating model, team responsibilities, and business rhythms needed to support a growing post-sales organization. In this role, you will drive operational rigor across resource management, P&L management, planning, intake and prioritization, and executive business reviews, while partnering closely with Customer Success leadership and cross-functional stakeholders. What you’ll do (Role Expectations) Establish and lead the Business Operations function for Customer Success, defining clear roles, responsibilities, and operating mechanisms to support Support, Technical Success, and Professional Services Own and evolve the operating cadence for the business, including Monthly Business Reviews, Quarterly Business Reviews (QBRs), Annual Operating Planning (AOP), and executive performance reviews Partner with Finance and Customer Success leadership to streamline resource management, capacity planning, investment prioritization, and P&L management across the post-sales organization Drive headcount planning, budget visibility, and investment tracking to help leaders make sound, data-driven business decisions Build and operationalize key KPIs, dashboards, and performance insights that provide visibility into business health, team performance, and operational efficiency in partnership with cross-functional teams Who You Are (Success Profile) You thrive in ambiguity and are comfortable building the path as you walk it in a dynamic environment, seeing ambiguity as the raw material to build something meaningful. You act like an owner with a passion for the mission that fuels your bias for action, operating with integrity and balancing strategic leadership with practical execution. You are a problem-solver who runs toward challenges and is energized by building structure, discipline, and solutions where they do not yet exist. You are a learner with a growth mindset, actively seeking feedback and continuously improving yourself, your team, and the way the business operates. You are a high-trust collaborator who builds strong partnerships through clarity, candor, and follow-through. What We’re Looking for (Minimum Qualifications) Demonstrated curiosity and active exploration of AI tools, with a proven history of integrating new technologies to enhance daily workflows and augment problem-solving 8+ years of experience in Business Operations within post-sales functions such as Professional Services, Customer Success, or Customer Support Experience leading teams and developing high-performing individuals in operational or business management environments Experience building a new function, operating model, or business process in a growing or evolving organization Strong experience with planning, resource management, P&L management, KPI development, executive reviews, and operating cadences Strong understanding of the customer journey and the operational needs of post-sales organizations in a high-growth B2B SaaS or technology environment What Will Make You Stand Out (Preferred Qualifications) Experience applying AI, automation, or advanced analytics to improve operational efficiency, business visibility, and customer outcomes within post-sales organizations Experience partnering closely with Finance on budget management, headcount planning, and business performance reviews Experience establishing or scaling monthly business reviews, QBRs, and AOP processes across multiple post-sales functions #LI-remote #LI-NH1 Zscaler’s salary ranges are benchmarked and are determined by role and level. The range displayed on each job posting reflects the minimum and maximum target for new hire salaries for the position across all US locations and could be higher or lower based on a multitude of factors, including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training. The base salary range listed for this full-time position excludes commission/ bonus/ equity (if applicable) + benefits. Base Pay Range $175,000—$250,000 USD At Zscaler, we are committed to building a team that reflects the communities we serve and the customers we work with. We foster an inclusive environment that values all backgrounds and perspectives, emphasizing collaboration and belonging. Join us in our mission to make doing business seamless and secure. Our Benefits program is one of the most important ways we support our employees. Zscaler proudly offers comprehensive and inclusive benefits to meet the diverse needs of our employees and their families throughout their life stages, including: Various health plans Time off plans for vacation and sick time Parental leave options Retirement options Education reimbursement In-office perks, and more! Learn more about Zscaler's hybrid working model and benefits here . Zscaler is committed to providing equal employment opportunities to all individuals. We strive to create a workplace where employees are treated with respect and have the chance to succeed. All qualified applicants will be considered for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy or related medical conditions), age, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, genetic information, disability status, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local laws. See more information by clicking on the Know Your Rights: Workplace Discrimination is Illegal link. Pay Transparency Zscaler complies with all applicable federal, state, and local pay transparency rules. items.description: About Securly Securly is the K-12 market leader in AI-powered student safety and wellness solutions, protecting more than 20 million students across 20,000+ schools. Our mission is to create safer, more supportive learning environments by detecting potential harm, supporting student mental health, and empowering educators with actionable insights that help students thrive. By turning data into meaningful, actionable intelligence, Securly enables schools to identify risk earlier, reduce harmful incidents, and strengthen student support — driving measurable improvements in safety and wellbeing. We're proud to be recognized as a Top Place to Work , named to TIME's America's Top EdTech Companies 2026 list, a Top 40 Most Used EdTech , and one of the 150 most transformational growth companies. The Role Securly is looking for a Director, Customer Success Operations to lead the systems, processes, and people behind our entire post-sale customer journey. You'll lead our CS Ops and Renewals function - a CS Ops Manager, a CS Ops Specialist, and a team of Renewals Specialists - and own Vitally, our Customer Success platform, as the operational backbone of the business. This is a builder's role. Vitally has been live for about a year, and the next chapter is yours to write: deepening adoption, sharpening health scoring, automating renewals workflows, and turning good instincts into a repeatable, data-driven system that scales. You'll be the operational thought partner to CS executives - using data and process design to make sure customer growth and success directly fuel Securly's growth. Location: Remote (U.S.) Type: Full-Time, Exempt Reports to: SVP, Customer Success What Success Looks Like In your first 90 days, you'll get under the hood - auditing our Vitally configuration, current CS Ops and renewals workflows, and team structure. You'll build real relationships with your team and ship your first wave of improvements: sharper health scoring, better dashboards, and a more programmatic renewals process. By 6 months, you're driving measurable gains - better renewals efficiency, stronger forecast accuracy, and dashboards that CS and company leadership actually rely on to run the business. By your first year, you own a mature CS Ops and Renewals function that consistently meets or exceeds retention targets, backed by a trained, accountable team and a Vitally instance that scales with Securly's growth. What You'll Do Lead the team Hire, coach, and manage a team of a CS Ops Manager, a CS Ops Specialist, and Renewals Specialists - setting clear goals and holding the team accountable to them Structure team capacity and coverage to match renewal volume and customer segmentation Build a real growth path for your team, from onboarding through career development Own the process Design, implement, and continuously refine scalable playbooks that support the entire post-sale customer journey Own the end-to-end renewal process - timely, accurate, and built to minimize churn Design and run a programmatic renewals process suited to a high-volume, complex customer base Turn data into decisions Own customer health scoring, tracking, and measurement across the install base Define and build the dashboards CS and executive leadership use to manage the business Surface customer insights to Product, Support, and Sales to drive real improvements Build the tech stack Serve as the internal owner of Vitally - driving adoption, configuration, and continuous optimization Identify, build, and implement Agentic AI and automation that genuinely moves the needle on CS Ops and renewals outcomes Manage the broader tech stack, including integrations with Salesforce and other GTM systems What We're Looking For 3+ years leading a Customer Success Operations, Revenue Operations, or Renewals team - this is a leadership track record, not an individual-contributor background, with proven experience scaling CS tools, systems, and AI Real examples of scaling a CS Ops function - taking a team, process, or system from early-stage to measurably better performance, with strong examples of building tools, systems, and process, and applying AI Hands-on experience building tech, systems, and automation - you've architected workflows, integrations, or automation inside a CS platform (Vitally, Gainsight, Totango, ChurnZero, or similar) and a CRM like Salesforce or HubSpot, not just used tools someone else set up Applied experience with Agentic AI and automation - you've actually built or implemented AI-driven workflows (like automated health scoring or renewals triage), not just explored the space A track record of building and coaching a team, with strong data analytics skills and fluency in core SaaS metrics (GRR, NRR, churn, CLV, NPS, CSAT) Strong project management skills and the ability to manage multiple cross-functional initiatives at once Experience in K-12, EdTech, or education-adjacent SaaS is a strong plus Why You'll Love Working at Securly Meaningful impact - build the operational engine behind a company that helps protect millions of students People-first culture - consistently recognized as a Top Place to Work Remote-first flexibility - work from home with a supportive, distributed team Real ownership - shape a growing platform and team, not maintain someone else's system Mission-driven work - what you build directly supports student safety and wellbeing Benefits & Perks Competitive salary up to $165K with performance incentives Medical, dental, and vision coverage 401(k) with employer match 12 weeks of fully paid parental leave Unlimited PTO, paid holidays, and a paid one-week year-end shutdown $1,000 annual professional development stipend Free mental health resources and Employee Assistance Program Equal Opportunity Employer Securly is committed to building a diverse and inclusive workplace. We do not discriminate based on race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, disability, or any other legally protected characteristic. Accommodations are available throughout the hiring process - just let us know at recruitment.us@securly.com #LI-Remote #LI-DO1

items.description: This role is part of our Central Platform Engineering Team at saas.group. What is saas.group? Think of us as the driving catalyst behind your favorite software success stories. saas.group, established in 2017, is on a mission to turbocharge promising B2B SaaS ventures, unlocking their full potential. As a Software-as-a-Service portfolio powerhouse, we specialize in acquiring small software treasures and polishing them into industry stars. With a dynamic, fully remote team of nearly 350+ colleagues spanning 50+ countries we are truly global and we are rewriting the playbook on SaaS innovation and collaboration. We grow 23 exciting brands under our umbrella. Feel free to explore our Candidate's Hub to get an insider's view, dive into our culture, gain valuable insights into our teams and how we work. Also, don’t forget to follow saas.group on LinkedIn to stay up-to-date on our job openings, podcast episodes, and with all things happening at our company. Profile Overview Our Platform Engineering team runs central infrastructure services and partners with brands to modernize their stacks. The mission: provide a “paved road” of opinionated best practices (observability, backups, CI/CD, infra as code) that brands can adopt quickly, and support hands-on migrations when needed. You’ll own outcomes for a set of brands: assess where they are, recommend what “good” looks like, and implement the plan. The role blends architecture, enablement, and practical engineering. It’s senior and autonomous: you’ll advise and sometimes convince stakeholders, then deliver. Your immediate impact in the first 3-6 months will be: Complete central onboarding by pairing with a team member for ~2 weeks to learn our patterns and tooling, then start managing the brands assigned to you. Lead the onboarding of at least one brand to our “paved road” standards (GitHub org, CI/CD, monitoring/observability, IaC), with positive feedback from brand leadership and our team. Deliver one or more migrations/refactors (e.g., CI/CD, infra modernization, cost/availability improvements) and document decisions so others can build on them. Your responsibilities Lead infrastructure projects for assigned brands: migrations, performance & reliability improvements, incident response practices, containerization, and cloud cost optimizations. Establish/upgrade CI/CD, infra as code, monitoring, alerting, and SLO-aligned dashboards; baseline and improve reliability with data. Advise brand CTOs/engineering leads on trade-offs and architecture; justify decisions with clear reasoning and measurable outcomes. Contribute to and consume central services (e.g., observability, backups) so brands don’t reinvent the wheel. Collaborate with developers as part of the product team during engagements; troubleshoot across app and infra boundaries. Bring AI into the paved road itself: use tools like Claude Code or Codex daily to speed up IaC, scripting, and incident diagnosis, and help brand teams pick up the same habits in their own workflows. Participate in an on-call rotation (lightweight today; scaling toward a fair, shared model). What You bring to the table 5+ years of experience in Platform or Cloud Engineering, DevOps, or Site Reliability Engineering roles, operating at a senior level with strong ownership and autonomy. Deep expertise in at least one major cloud provider (AWS, GCP, or Azure) and practical experience with Infrastructure as Code (ideally Terraform). Solid understanding of CI/CD concepts and best practices; able to assess, design, and modernize pipelines across diverse brand environments. Experience with monitoring and observability tools (Datadog, New Relic, ELK, Prometheus, or similar) and sound judgment on what “good” looks like. Hands-on, daily use of AI coding tools (Claude Code, Codex, or similar) in real infra work, not just curiosity about them; comfortable coaching brand teams on how to use them well. A background in software development or the ability to read and debug application code. Excellent communication and consulting skills; confident in advising and influencing technical stakeholders while adapting to different teams and tech stacks. What’s in it for You Ultimate flexibility: We’re 100% remote. You can work from wherever you like, whenever you like. Freedom and autonomy: We’re a high-trust team, and you’ll be given lots of flexibility to solve problems in your own way — with plenty of help from the team when you need it. Minimum bureaucracy: We don’t like to get bogged down with meetings and red tape. We like to be efficient and keep momentum steady & sustainable. Small & friendly team: We help each other out, have fun, and joke around. Our network: We are a community of entrepreneurial SaaS professionals that regularly exchange ideas, knowledge, learning and expertise with each other internally. Flexible time off: We want you to recharge your batteries when needed. We don’t just simply offer you to “take a job with us” but rather to “join us on this journey” to build the world's largest platform of independent SaaS companies. Sounds like something you’re up for? Feel free to apply even if you don’t check all these boxes. We believe in the power of diversity and fresh perspectives to spice up our team. Your application might just be the missing ingredient! — saas.group is committed to creating a diverse and inclusive workplace. We are proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability, age, or veteran status. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. If you're passionate about working with a team that values innovation, excellence, and fairness, we encourage you to apply. We believe in fair and transparent pay. Salary ranges at saas.group are location-adjusted, targeting local market medians for a remote-first environment, and will be shared with our potential future employees in writing before your first interview - so you have everything you need to evaluate the opportunity.

items.title: Chief Financial Officer
items.summary: We're so happy you're here! Thank you for checking our job out and we hope to have the chance to meet you in our interview process!
items.description: We're so happy you're here! Thank you for checking our job out and we hope to have the chance to meet you in our interview process! About the role The CFO’s mission is to continue building upon Grüns ' already strong finance and data function — evolving it into a best-in-class engine that empowers the entire organization to make faster, smarter decisions. Leading a team of three strong leaders, this role is about leading the strong teams below them to democratize financial intelligence across the Grüns organization: self-serve dashboards, on-demand reporting, and real-time visibility that puts decision-making power in the hands of every team member. The CFO is a relentless, collaborative business partner, never satisfied with where the business is on revenue scale or profitability, always pushing for the next point of EBITDA margin improvement across all functions and driving efficiency to fuel continued revenue growth. They will ensure Grüns scales with confidence while meeting all external requirements seamlessly in the background. This role is part of our remote HQ! We have a fully remote, high-trust work environment - and also come together on a biannual basis for amazing off-sites where we can connect IRL. What success looks like: If we look ahead a year from now, the right person in this role would have: Leveraged what we’ve built so far, found areas for improvement, and fully operationalized a goal accountability framework that keeps business initiatives tied to financial outcomes, ensuring the leadership team is consistently tracking toward revenue and profitability targets. Driven meaningful EBITDA margin improvement across all functions and improved LTV:CAC efficiency to fuel continued revenue growth. Delivered self-serve dashboards, templatized reporting, and real-time P&L visibility across functions so every team has the data access they need without relying on ad-hoc requests. Business decisions are democratized and exponentially quicker. Created the conditions for a high-performing, motivated team empowering vs. micromanaging, actively developing leaders, and driving strong results and performance without burnout. Built the systems and processes to meet all external reporting and compliance requirements seamlessly, keeping the team focused on growth. We're looking for someone with: Relentless Growth Mindset: Always asking what it takes to get to the next level, whether that's another point of margin, better efficiency, or a faster path to revenue growth - a genuine internal drive to make the business the best it can be. Finding new opportunities across the business and proposing these opportunities to the CEO and functional leads. Integrity and Business-First Thinking: Prioritizes the truth over “looking good”. Navigates competing stakeholder interests honestly and thoroughly rather than taking the path of least resistance. Empowering Leadership: Leads by giving people the tools, clarity, and confidence to make great decisions vs. controlling the work directly. Actively develops their functional leaders, makes their team better than they were before. Drives sustainable high performance. Paper Wall Pusher: Treats perceived constraints as hypotheses, not facts. When told something takes six weeks or "this is how it's done," they ask why and push for faster, smarter, or different. Actively hunts for process bloat and inherited ways of working to find improvements. AI-Native Operator: Uses AI natively in their own workflow and actively builds AI fluency into the team's operating model. Sees AI as a core lever for scaling the function's impact without scaling headcount. Direct, but kind: Direct and honest in every conversation, saying what needs to be said, even when it's uncomfortable. Deeply committed to the business and the people in it. Experience: 10+ years leadership experience in a high-growth, profitable businesses; some level of physical inventory experience (CPG, retail, e-commerce, or similar) is a must Experience leading the functions in scope - finance, accounting, data, and BizOps functions Experience within a high-growth company that is adapting to public company practices Compensation & Benefits: At Grüns , we're committed to providing a competitive total compensation package — grounded in market data that considers our size, stage, industry, and location. For this role, the base salary is $350,000 + incentive compensation, paired with a comprehensive benefits package designed to support the well-being and growth of our team. A bit about us... At Grüns , we believe that foundational nutrition should be simple and convenient for everyone. We're dedicated to bringing comprehensive and real nutrition to you through our gummies, formulated from 60 nutrient-dense and whole-food ingredients. Simply enjoy a grab-and-go snack pack of gummies daily whenever fits best in your schedule and wherever life takes you. Like you, we were disappointed. There’s an infinite number of “nutrition” companies, all focused on what’s best for them — not what’s best for you. Hundreds of products to sell you on, low-quality ingredients, and small nutrient doses. We’ve seen it all. So we decided it was time to fix it. No more choking on and popping pills like a pharmacy. No more clean-up and disgust from gross powders. And no more cobbling together handfuls to dozens of supplements. Grüns is comprehensive nutrition, made convenient and delicious. What we care about... Be the Best: We hold ourselves, our teams, and our partners to an incredibly high standard - and we raise the bar constantly. "We've never done this before" isn't an excuse here. It's an invitation. Own It: We act like our name is on the door. That means taking complete ownership of outcomes, collaborating deeply, working through roadblocks - not around them - and never waiting for someone else to solve the problem. Great owners are great partners. Drive Impact, Urgently: We measure impact, not effort. We work smart and hard, move fast, and use every tool at our disposal - including AI - to focus our energy where it matters most. Compensation & Perks: For every role, we aim to have highly competitive compensation and opportunity for impact and career growth. Everyone at Grüns works hard, but we believe in wellness and balance too. We have super strong benefits coverage -- for you and your family, generous PTO, free Grüns subscriptions, and a few more perks centered around health and well-being that we can't wait to tell you about! items.title: PnP Pipeline On-call Support Engineer
items.summary: Role SummaryYour primary mission is to ensure the consistent health and stability of our PnP (Power and Performance) pipelines.
items.description: Role Summary Your primary mission is to ensure the consistent health and stability of our PnP (Power and Performance) pipelines. You will serve as the first line of defense, monitoring pipelines and performing initial triaging to reduce manual overhead for our engineering teams. This role is critical to maintaining the velocity of our post-silicon PnP work as we scale. Core Responsibilities Pipeline Monitoring: Conduct regular, proactive health checks on functional and PnP-enabled flows. Ensure data integrity by verifying that test results are populating correctly on the RLS PnP dashboard. Initial Triage: Investigate pipeline failures and categorize them to streamline resolution: Infrastructure/Deployment Issues: CI pools, hargow issues, or platform environments (e.g., Artemis/Coleman HW/FW mismatches). UTF / PnP Analyzer Issues: Troubleshoot problems within the Unified Test Framework (UTF) or artifact deployment. Mature Pipeline Issues: Address issues specific to pipeline logic for stable flows that are no longer under active development. Resolution & Escalation: Perform bug fixes for straightforward issues (e.g., patching deployment or execution changes). For infrastructure issues, post to the appropriate internal channels for escalation and follow-up. Escalate complex or systemic issues to pipeline owners by providing necessary logs and context. Collaborate with pipeline owners and XFN (Cross-Functional) DRIs to ensure proper placement of PnP trace tags and alignment of measurement windows. Qualifications & Technical Requirements Core Requirements: Proven experience in monitoring alerts and dashboards. Strong troubleshooting skills with the ability to identify patterns in failure logs and suggest improvements. Ability to differentiate between infrastructure, firmware, and analyzer-specific errors. Preferred Qualifications: Familiarity with jest-e2e and the Unified Test Framework (UTF). Experience working within internal infrastructure (e.g., buck, sandcastle, phabricator, internal AI tooling). Ability to read and interpret CI pipeline logs effectively. Ability to leverage AI tooling effectively (claude code, Metamate, etc.) Originally posted on Himalayas

items.title: Sr. Clinical Operations Manager
items.summary: About Carrot: Carrot is the leading global fertility and family care platform, built on intelligent care orchestration: the right clinical guidance, at the right moment, in the context of each member’s life.
items.description: About Carrot: Carrot is the leading global fertility and family care platform, built on intelligent care orchestration: the right clinical guidance, at the right moment, in the context of each member’s life. More than a thousand multinational employers, health plans, and health systems trust Carrot to support millions of members across 195 countries – from pre-pregnancy through menopause and major life moments in between. Carrot's comprehensive clinical program delivers industry-leading cost savings for plan sponsors and award-winning experiences and improved outcomes for millions of people worldwide. Carrot is widely regarded as a defining force in healthcare innovation as a recipient of several top-tier awards, including Fast Company's 'Most Innovative Companies' and CNBC's '100 Barrier Breaking Startups'. The company is regularly cited by leading global outlets — including The Economist, Bloomberg, The Wall Street Journal, NPR, ABC News, and Harvard Business Review — as a leading voice on digital health, the future of work, and family health. Learn more at . The Opportunity 🚀 This role serves as the operational backbone of the Global Clinical Operations (GCO) team, developing a deep understanding of GCO's day-to-day workings in order to help operationalize its running. You'll coordinate new projects, identify the right stakeholders, and partner closely with the GCO team, including GCO clinical leadership, to keep programs running smoothly. This is a hands-on operations role where success is measured by reliable execution, clean reporting, and strong cross-functional coordination. You'll be the connective tissue between GCO sub-teams and partners across product, commercial, GTM, and customer success, giving you visibility into how clinical operations decisions ripple across the business. What You’ll Own 💼 In this role, you will: Serve as the operations point person across GCO sub-teams, keeping frameworks, timelines, and ways of working consistent. Coordinate the GCO components of new projects end-to-end: identify stakeholders, track deliverables, and keep work moving across global clinical operations, product, and other partner teams. Track spend against program budgets, flagging variances to leadership. Spot and help close gaps or silos between GCO sub-teams by maintaining regular alignment touchpoints. Build and maintain dashboards and reporting infrastructure that give leadership real-time visibility into program status, trends, and open decisions. Pull together monthly operational updates, synthesizing data from Jira, Zendesk, Airtable, Salesforce, BI tools, and other program analytics into clear, actionable summaries. Help connect operational metrics to clinical and business outcomes so leadership has a clear line of sight from day-to-day activity to impact. Serve as a connector between GCO and commercial, GTM, and customer success teams, ensuring the right subject-matter expert is looped into RFPs, RFIs, and retention/expansion conversations. Ensure feedback from client-facing teams is incorporated into GCO program planning and prioritization. Identify opportunities to use AI tools, automation, and workflow improvements to save the team time and reduce manual work. Support team members in getting up to speed on new tools and best practices as they're introduced. What Success Looks Like 📈 In your first 12–18 months, you will have: Created and rolled out dashboards and reporting infrastructure that are adopted by GCO leadership.Improved operational efficiency across GCO, including reduced redundant meetings and streamlined recurring processes.Established a strong working rhythm with key GCO leadership and cross-functional partners. Successfully managed multiple projects concurrently, hitting key milestones and deadlines, with consistent reporting/status updates so stakeholders always know where each project stands. About You ✨ You likely have: A Bachelor's degree in healthcare administration, business, public health, or a related field — or equivalent practical experience in clinical/healthcare operations. Demonstrated, hands-on experience in scheduling, budgets, and cross-functional coordination within clinical operations. Strong program and process-design skills, shown through a program management certification or 2+ years of project management experience, including building/maintaining SOPs, governance documentation, and decision-informing reporting. High comfort level with modern productivity and data tools (Google Workspace, Slack, Jira, Salesforce, Airtable, BI dashboards) and the ability to quickly learn new systems, including AI-enabled tools. A demonstrated ability to operate across multiple fast-moving workstreams simultaneously without losing track of details. Strong documentation skills, with the ability to create and maintain clear, reusable, well-organized documentation. Extreme organization, with the ability to manage and maintain large databases and datasets accurately. The ability to establish a process and cadence for audits, ensuring data and documentation stay accurate and current over time. Nice to Have ⭐ While not required, we would be especially excited if you bring: Experience in reproductive and/or hormonal health (fertility, pregnancy, menopause, low testosterone, gender-affirming care) and related coverage/benefit policies. A track record of using data to drive decisions — defining KPIs, building dashboards, running monthly/quarterly operational reviews. Comfortable operating in high-growth, ambiguous environments with a bias toward scalable systems and automation. Why This Role Matters 🧡 This role sits at the center of Carrot's Global Clinical Operations function, translating day-to-day execution into the reporting and coordination that leadership relies on to make decisions. By keeping GCO's sub-teams aligned and connecting clinical operations to commercial and customer-facing teams, this person directly shapes how reliably Carrot delivers on its clinical programs — and how clearly that impact gets communicated across the business. Why Candidates Join Carrot 🌍 Carrot offers the opportunity to do meaningful work in service of a deeply human mission. Highlights include: A mission-driven company focused on expanding access to fertility and family-forming care globally. A high-growth environment where leaders are empowered to shape strategy and drive impact. Competitive compensation, equity, and comprehensive benefits. Flexible Time Off and a culture that actively encourages employees to recharge. Comprehensive parental leave and family-forming benefits. A collaborative, inclusive, and values-driven culture. The opportunity to work alongside passionate, thoughtful teammates committed to improving healthcare outcomes worldwide. Compensation 💰 Carrot offers a holistic Total Rewards package designed to support our employees in all aspects of their life inside and outside of work, including health and wellness benefits, retirement savings plans, short- and long-term incentives, parental leave, family-forming assistance, and a competitive compensation package. The starting base salary for this position will range from$128,000.00 - $150,000.00. Actual compensation may vary from the posted base salary depending on your confirmed job-related skills and experience. Fraud and Security Notice: Please note that all communication regarding job opportunities at Carrot will come exclusively from an @get-carrot.com email address. If you receive messages from any other domain, please disregard them and report the incident to: A Note on AI At Carrot, we believe AI can help us work smarter, move faster, and create more meaningful experiences for our members, customers, and each other. While not every role requires deep technical AI expertise, we value people who are curious, eager to learn, and excited to thoughtfully incorporate AI into their day-to-day work. For some roles, AI fluency is a core requirement—and we'll call that out clearly in the qualifications. For everyone else, we're looking for people who embrace new ways of working, use AI responsibly to improve quality and efficiency, and continue to learn as the technology evolves. Why Carrot? Carrot has received national and international recognition for its pioneering work, including Fast Company's Most Innovative Companies and World Changing Ideas, Inc. Power Partners, and Modern Healthcare’s Innovators. Carrot’s global workforce has been acknowledged with several accolades, including Fortune’s Best Workplaces in Healthcare, Great Place to Work, and Age-Friendly Employer certifications. Carrot is regularly featured in media reporting on issues related to the future of work, women in leadership, and healthcare innovation, including MSNBC, The Economist, Bloomberg, The Wall Street Journal, CNBC, National Public Radio, Harvard Business Review, and more. Learn more at carrotfertility.com. Originally posted on Himalayas

items.description: About this Role We're looking for a Business Partner Manager to serve as the operational right hand to our Senior VP, ensuring strategy turns into execution across multiple global e-commerce brands. You'll work across Creative, Performance Marketing, Data, Technology, Partnerships, Finance, and Operations to keep priorities aligned, teams accountable, and projects moving at speed. Success in this role isn't measured by how many meetings you attend—it's measured by how effectively you remove bottlenecks, build scalable systems, keep teams accountable, and enable the Senior VP to focus on growing the business. You could be a great fit if... You naturally bring structure and clarity to fast-moving, complex environments. You enjoy turning strategy into actionable execution plans that teams can follow. You can confidently manage multiple workstreams, stakeholders, and priorities without losing attention to detail. You proactively identify risks, remove blockers, and keep projects moving before issues escalate. You're comfortable holding senior stakeholders and cross-functional teams accountable for delivery. You enjoy building processes, SOPs, and operational systems that improve efficiency and scalability. You communicate clearly across departments and know how to align different teams around shared goals. You're commercially minded and understand how operational excellence drives business growth. You're excited to work in an AI-first company and contribute to improving internal workflows through automation. What You'll Do Partner closely with the Senior VP to drive operational execution across multiple brands and strategic initiatives. Own end-to-end management of Statements of Work (SOWs), ensuring clear scope, timelines, commercial alignment, and zero scope creep. Oversee execution across Creative, Paid Media, UGC, Content, and other cross-functional teams to ensure projects stay on track. Build visibility across multiple brands by proactively identifying risks, dependencies, and execution bottlenecks. items.title: Liquidity Operations Analyst
items.summary: Work with the bestWe are Orderly, the ultimate destination for decentralized trading platforms.
items.description: Work with the best We are Orderly, the ultimate destination for decentralized trading platforms. We are not satisfied with the limitations of centralized exchanges or the complexities of building decentralized order books. We aim to make trading easy, fast, and secure for everyone. How? By fusing the simplicity of CeFi with the power of DeFi. At the heart of the issue lies “liquidity”. Builders often grapple with a paradox; traders need liquidity, but liquidity demands traders. Our solution is simple as is bold –concentrate all liquidity into one order book. One order book that connects all the liquidity in the crypto space. Our ambition doesn't stop there. We're omnichain, championing chain abstraction. We envision seamless transactions, where the underlying blockchain is merely a detail. By concentrating liquidity, we aim to redefine the crypto landscape, making bridging and wrapped assets a thing of the past. We are Orderly, and we are here to revolutionize DeFi, democratizing access to financial opportunities and fostering a fair, equitable paradigm for all. A Glimpse into Your Future at Orderly Network What will you be working on? Process, clean, and validate liquidity and trading data to ensure accuracy and usability. Extract and transform trading data to generate regular reports (weekly/monthly) and support alerting mechanisms. Monitor liquidity dashboards and identify anomalies in a timely manner. Maintain and update market parameter configuration tables. Support market maker onboarding and assist with incentive distribution processes. Participate in data analysis for liquidity mechanism design and assist in testing new incentive models. Who will you be working with? Work closely with the liquidity operations team on daily monitoring and execution. Collaborate with product, trading, and data teams to ensure data accuracy and operational efficiency. Support coordination with market makers during onboarding and ongoing operations. What challenges will you face? Handling large volumes of trading data with high accuracy requirements. Identifying anomalies and ensuring data quality in a fast-moving trading environment. Balancing data processing, monitoring, and operational support tasks simultaneously. Adapting quickly to evolving liquidity strategies and incentive mechanisms. Interested in Learning More? Our hiring process begins by meeting with our People Team, who help facilitate the process of placing you in your new role. You can expect to share your experience and ideas in online video interviews with our hiring team, made up of management and potential new colleagues. If you have experience in developing trading systems or financial-related products is a plus. You can prepare for this interview by mentally organizing your strategies and opinions on topics such as Web3, cryptocurrency trading platforms, and your vision of how to succeed. Share this! Don’t be afraid of friends or co-workers stealing this job! If you are amazing and smart we will find a place for you. Check out our External Referral Incentives Program as well. We use a multi-faceted approach for flexibility, depending on the various roles in our organization. Working at Bank of America will give you a great career with opportunities to learn, grow and make an impact, along with the power to make a difference. Join us! Global Business Services Global Business Services delivers Technology and Operations capabilities to Lines of Business and Staff Support Functions of Bank of America through a centrally managed, globally integrated delivery model and globally resilient operations. Global Business Services is recognized for flawless execution, sound risk management, operational resiliency, operational excellence and innovation. In India, we are present in five locations and operate as BA Continuum India Private Limited (BACI), a non-banking subsidiary of Bank of America Corporation and the operating company for India operations of Global Business Services. items.description: Sales and Marketing Headquarters: San Francisco or New York or US-Remote Who we are About Stripe Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies - from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups - use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone's reach while doing the most important work of your career. About the team The Global Executive Marketing team builds and scales Stripe’s most strategic executive engagement programs, including Executive Briefing Centers, Executive Summit, Customer Advisory Boards, World Economic Forum activations, executive sponsorship, and regional executive experiences. Our mission is to deepen trust with senior decision-makers, accelerate enterprise outcomes, and create durable executive-level relationships across Stripe’s most important accounts. What you’ll do Stripe's most important enterprise relationships are won and deepened through sustained, thoughtful executive engagement, not one-off touchpoints. As the Executive Lifecycle Marketing Manager, you will own the strategy and execution for how Stripe nurtures senior decision-makers across its priority accounts: developing personalized, account-specific approaches that meet executives where they are in their relationship with Stripe, then translating those individual plays into scalable lifecycle journeys that work across executive personas and account segments. This role requires a seller's mindset. You understand what's meaningful to a particular executive, what stage of the relationship they're in, and what it will take to deepen trust and move things forward. You also know how to zoom out: distilling what works at the individual account level into programs and playbooks that can scale across similar audiences. This is a creative and analytical role in equal measure — you'll be as comfortable crafting a personalized engagement plan as you are building a pipeline dashboard. Responsibilities Design and execute account-specific engagement plans for Stripe's priority executive accounts, tailoring tactics and sequencing to each executive's business priorities, relationship stage, and opportunity with Stripe Build scalable lifecycle journey frameworks that translate individual account learnings into repeatable playbooks for executive personas and account cohorts so the best approaches compound over time Map and manage the executive lifecycle across key accounts: identify where relationships stand, what's needed to progress them, and what program or tactic is the right next step Partner closely with field sales and regional teams to understand account dynamics, executive priorities, and relationship goals, then develop coordinated marketing plays that accelerate those outcomes Orchestrate multi-touch engagement sequences across executive programs (EBCs, roundtable dinners, advisory boards, hospitality, 1:1 outreach) as integrated, lifecycle-aware campaigns rather than standalone events Own pipeline and ROI reporting for executive engagement — build dashboards and measurement frameworks that track relationship progression, program influence on pipeline velocity, and business impact Partner with executive program owners to ensure each program serves a clear lifecycle purpose and connects to the broader account engagement model Align cross-functional stakeholders (Sales, Marketing, executive offices) around account-level priorities and shared engagement plans Who you are We're looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement. items.description: Are you passionate about cutting edge technology? Do solving some of the Internet's most difficult content delivery challenges interest you? Join our highly skilled Site Reliability team Our team designs, develops, and manages applications and infrastructure that support Akamai's Compute products and services. We do this while maintaining Akamai's mission at the forefront of what we do. Make life better for billions of people, billions of times a day. Partner with the best The Senior Engineer creates solutions to improve automation and efficiency for systems and teams. Responsibilities include optimizing workflows, infrastructure, and applications. Expertise in Linux administration, configuration management, and performance tuning is essential. Collaborate on deployment, monitoring, and resolving incidents. Focus on reliability, scalability, and efficiency through automation and resource optimization. Promote continuous improvement and operational excellence across all systems. As a Senior Site Reliability Engineer, you will be: Providing support and mentorship for other engineers within the department Developing and maintaining automated tools and scripts to enhance system reliability, deployment processes, and incident response efficiency. Improving our system monitoring to speed error detection and remediation, enhancing performance and reliability of virtualization platform Participating in on-call rotations, guiding restoration and repair of service-impacting issues Writing automation and tooling to reduce operational toil, improve deployment safety, and accelerate incident response Contributing to capacity planning, autoscaling configuration, and workload scheduling for AI compute infrastructure Do what you love To be successful in this role you will: Possess expert level experience in a SysAdmin (Linux/Unix Administration), DevOps or SRE role, working with large scale distributed systems Demonstrate expertise in Kubernetes and large-scale containerization systems. Possess at least one programming language (Python/Golang) and configuration management with Terraform/SaltStack/Ansible Define SLOs and work with observability tools like Prometheus, Grafana, and distributed tracing to enhance system monitoring. Have experience with architecting software and infrastructure at scale Demonstrate accountability for reliability, develop automation and monitoring, and collaborate effectively with an engineering team unfamiliar with SRE practices. Work in a way that works for you FlexBase, Akamai's Global Flexible Working Program, is based on the principles that are helping us create the best workplace in the world. When our colleagues said that flexible working was important to them, we listened. We also know flexible working is important to many of the incredible people considering joining Akamai. FlexBase, gives 95% of employees the choice to work from their home, their office, or both (in the country advertised). This permanent workplace flexibility program is consistent and fair globally, to help us find incredible talent, virtually anywhere. We are happy to discuss working options for this role and encourage you to speak with your recruiter in more detail when you apply. Learn what makes Akamai a great place to work Connect with us on social and see what life at Akamai is like! We power and protect life online, by solving the toughest challenges, together. At Akamai, we're curious, innovative, collaborative and tenacious. We celebrate diversity of thought and we hold an unwavering belief that we can make a meaningful difference. Our teams use their global perspectives to put customers at the forefront of everything they do, so if you are people-centric, you'll thrive here. Working for you At Akamai, we will provide you with opportunities to grow, flourish, and achieve great things. Our benefit options are designed to meet your individual needs for today and in the future. We provide benefits surrounding all aspects of your life: Your health Your finances Your family Your time at work Your time pursuing other endeavors Our benefit plan options are designed to meet your individual needs and budget, both today and in the future. About us Akamai powers and protects life online. Leading companies worldwide choose Akamai to build, deliver, and secure their digital experiences helping billions of people live, work, and play every day. With the world's most distributed compute platform from cloud to edge we make it easy for customers to develop and run applications, while we keep experiences closer to users and threats farther away. Join us Are you seeking an opportunity to make a real difference in a company with a global reach and exciting services and clients? Come join us and grow with a team of people who will energize and inspire you! #LI-Remote
